jobs.title: Research Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179954 **Category** Administration
  
In order for your application to be considered, please attached a cover letter and CV to your employment application.


**Position Description**


The Schaeffer Institute is seeking a **Research Program Specialist** to provide high\-level administrative leadership for the USC Mann Department of Pharmaceutical \& Health Economics, and to take on new programmatic support for the Institute leadership team and its growing modeling research program. Working with established and up\-and\-coming scholars, the **Research Program Specialist** will develop and spearhead new procedures and processes to support an in\-demand research team and their work with sophisticated data and modeling tools developed at the Institute. The **Research Program Specialist** will assist in program development and ensure that deadlines and milestones are met. The position will report to the Schaeffer Institute Director of Operations (in coordination with respective departmental leadership), who will help oversee the portfolio of work and ensure a collaborative and creative work environment across teams. The right candidate will contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape priorities to ensure leadership and program success.


This position offers a unique opportunity in the substantive work of a policy research center and an important academic department. The right candidate will have administrative expertise, high attention to detail, and enthusiasm for supporting a robust research agenda, faculty activities, and student engagement. The Schaeffer Institute serves a varied group of internal and external constituents—including students, academics, executives, philanthropists, and leading policymakers and staffers—across the political spectrum. Demonstrated experience working with leading faculty and scholars to support research goals is a plus.


**Research Program Leadership**


* Coordinate administrative functions for the modeling research program and other research initiatives as directed by Schaeffer leadership, including acting as a point of contact, responding to requests and inquiries, and managing program content.
* Assist program leadership and key stakeholders with anaylsis, research, and presentations.
* Manage program deadlines; coordinating and tracking grants, projects, and timelines to ensure deliverables and milestones are met.
* Support reporting and proposal development, including budget tracking, grant submissions, and compliance processes.
* Coordinate and contribute to research studies, proposals, and grant\-related research activities.
* Contribute to administrative leadership team meetings and support to Schaeffer academic and policy programming as time allows.

**Department Leadership**


* Oversee Department Chair’s administrative duties by managing calendars, coordinating meetings, preparing course materials, and assisting with day\-to\-day departmental operations for leading faculty.
* Organize departmental events, including conferences, seminars, special events and faculty meetings by managing logistics, vendor communications, facilities, catering, guest accommodations, and event execution.
* Collaborate with the USC Mann communications department to maintain and update the department website, ensuring accurate content, multimedia displays, and compliance with program policies.
* Execute two full\-cycle faculty recruitment searches by arranging candidate travel, accommodations, campus itineraries, interview schedules, and job talks; contributing to the successful hiring of two junior faculty members.
* Lead academic program services and activities including course scheduling, student recruitment initiatives, student summer programs, graduate program’s brown bag series, prospective student visit days, and new student orientation.
* Support graduate students’ academic progress by coordinating dissertation defenses, including scheduling, room reservations, logistics, technology setup, and day\-of\-event coordination to ensure successful execution.
* Act as the liaison between graduate students and the GAO, facilitating effective communication and ensuring students receive accurate information and support throughout their time in the program.
* Manage department faculty, students, and Schaeffer Center member travel, travel reimbursements.
* Process journal publication fees, manuscript edits, and purchase research materials while ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.

**Minimum Education:**


Bachelor’s degree


**Minimum Experience:**


2 years of relevant experience


**Compensation**


Commensurate with experience and qualifications. Position is 100% FTE


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.


The hourly rate range for this position is $40\.95 \- $46\.28\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.


**Work Arrangement**


Expected to work onsite 2\-3 days per week at USC University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA


**Fixed Term Position**


This is a full time, fixed term position through June 30, 2029 (with the possibility of renewal) with a hybrid work arrangement


**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**


The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy \& Government Service develops evidence\-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

jobs.title: Parking Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
Parking Administrative Coordinator – Lucas Museum of Narrative Art  

Los Angeles, CA \| Full\-time \| $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour (DOE)


About the Museum  

Opening September 2026, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is the first museum dedicated to visual storytelling. Located in Exposition Park, we're looking for a Parking Administrative Coordinator to manage the behind\-the\-scenes operations that keep our parking running smoothly — ensuring every guest has a seamless experience from the moment they arrive.


Our Culture  

We believe great service starts with great people. Our team thrives on taking pride in their work, staying calm when things get busy, showing up because the team counts on them, and supporting each other.  

We invest in our people and treat every role as essential.


The Position  

You are the organizational backbone of our parking operation. As the Parking Administrative Coordinator, you'll manage the SKIDATA parking access and revenue control system, process invoices and validations, handle customer and tenant account requests, and ensure accurate revenue reporting. You're the go\-to person for walk\-in, phone, and email inquiries — keeping everything accurate, organized, and running smoothly behind the scenes.

### **What You'll Do**


SKIDATA \& System Operations:

* Operate and troubleshoot SKIDATA PARCS — gate arms, payment kiosks, ticket dispensers, and validation stations
* Set up, update, and deactivate monthly parker, tenant, and employee accounts
* Issue and program access cards, credentials, and gate transponders


Invoicing \& Reconciliation:

* Prepare and process monthly parking, tenant, and client invoices
* Validate vendor invoices against SKIDATA reports, contracts, and rate schedules
* Pull and review daily, weekly, and monthly revenue and occupancy reports
* Reconcile reported revenue against bank deposits and accounting records


Customer \& Administrative Support:

* Respond to parking requests by phone, email, and in person — permits, access issues, validations, lost tickets, and billing disputes
* Maintain accurate records of permits, validations, invoices, and account changes
* Support month\-end and audit processes with compiled reports and documentation


What We Offer

* Pay: $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full\-time schedule with consistent weekly hours
* A supportive team culture that treats every role as essential
* Growth opportunities — many supervisors and managers started in operational roles

### **Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum age 18 or older
* SKIDATA PARCS experience strongly preferred; other PARCS platforms considered
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers and records
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Clear, professional communication skills — by phone, email, and in person
* Ability to organize, prioritize, and track multiple tasks with minimal supervision
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial, payment, and personal information


Preferred:

* Experience processing invoices, accounts receivable/payable, or revenue reconciliation
* College coursework in business, accounting, or a related field
* Bilingual skills are a plus


Key Traits:

* Detail\-oriented and accurate
* Customer\-focused and professional
* Calm under pressure and reliable
* Organized and able to multitask
* Enjoys a structured, fast\-paced office environment


Physical Requirements:

* Sit, stand, and move between office and garage/lot areas as needed
* Use hands and fingers to operate computer, phone, and access\-control equipment
* Observe screens, reports, and records for accuracy
* Hear and respond to customers, phone calls, and radio communications
* Lift and carry up to 15–20 pounds occasionally


Ready to apply?  

We review every application personally and move quickly. If you're organized, detail\-focused, and ready to be part of something historic, we want to hear from you.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. The Sales Coordinator supports the sales team by managing client communications, preparing proposals and agreements, maintaining accurate information in sales systems and CRM platforms, coordinating group and catering details, and ensuring effective communication between hotel departments.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced hospitality environment. This individual should demonstrate strong communication skills, professionalism, follow\-through, and the ability to work collaboratively with clients, guests, vendors, and hotel team members.**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
=============================================


Other duties may be assigned.* Supports the sales team with proposals, contracts, correspondence, reports, presentations, and client communications.
* Solicits and follows up with clients and prospects by phone, email, and in person to identify catering, social, group, and business opportunities.
* Maintains accurate prospect, account, group, catering, meeting, and activity information in sales systems and CRM platforms.
* Prepares catering proposals and agreements in accordance with hotel standards and client requirements.
* Coordinates booking details, including guest rooms, food and beverage, meeting space, room setups, audiovisual needs, billing arrangements, and special requests.

* Provides backup support to the Reservations team when needed, including accurately recording and relaying messages.
* Supports local sales efforts, including outreach to businesses and organizations, as requested.
* Performs other tasks and assignments as requested by management.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and details simultaneously.
* Professional telephone manner and the ability to interact effectively with clients, guests, vendors, and hotel team members.
* Clear and effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and sales systems or CRM platforms.
* Ability to prepare professional proposals, contracts, correspondence, and other business documents.
* Ability to communicate pertinent booking and event information accurately across hotel departments.
* Knowledge of meeting\-room setups and audiovisual equipment; experience with lighting, sound, or other event technology is preferred.
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and objectivity under pressure.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of guest, client, financial, and hotel information.
* Professional appearance and conduct at all times while on duty.
* Regular attendance and flexibility to work schedules that support client needs and catering functions.

**Qualifications**
==================

* High school diploma or GED and six months to one year of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Hospitality, customer service, or administrative experience is preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret documents, correspondence, and memos and communicate information verbally and in writing.
* Ability to effectively present information in one\-on\-one and group situations to guests, vendors, visitors, and employees.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals, and to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation may be required for local sales calls.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**
==============================================

* The work environment is primarily indoors, and the noise level is generally low to moderate.
* The position may require regular movement throughout the hotel, including standing, walking, bending, and navigating meeting and event spaces.
* The employee may be required to assist with event materials and work extended or flexible hours based on client and event needs.

This position works closely with the Marketing team, internal departments, restaurant teams, leadership, vendors, and agency partners to help keep projects organized, deadlines on track, and marketing initiatives moving forward.


The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, resourceful, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.description:
**About Observable Space**
--------------------------


At Observable Space, we're redefining how humanity observes and connects with the universe. We're a vertically integrated, high\-growth, space technology company building industry\-leading precision optics platforms for Earth and in space. Our systems are trusted by thousands of customers, including NASA, JPL, SpaceX, Boeing, RTX, the US Space Force and the U.S. Department of War, leading research institutions and international partners.


We combine precision opto\-mechanical hardware, embedded compute, cloud orchestration, and developer\-friendly APIs into world class products at scale with in\-house manufacturing. From advanced ground stations, on\-orbit sensor suites, free space optical lasercom, to distributed compute platforms, we deliver the foundational systems enabling continuous, real\-time navigation, observation, and communication in space.


Observable Space is backed by top\-tier institutional investors including Lux Capital, Upfront Ventures, RTX Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners and Embedded Ventures. To learn more, visit observable.space.

**About the Role**
------------------


Observable Space is hiring an Operations Coordinator to join our growing Business Operations function and bring structure, ownership and follow through to critical business processes across the company. You’ll start by building structure around contract administration and expand into operational tracking, documentation, vendor coordination, and broader business operations responsibilities as the company grows.


A major initial focus will be contract administration. Without an internal legal or contracts function, agreements ranging from customer contracts and vendor agreements to NDAs require disciplined coordination — preparing and routing documents for review and signature, tracking status and key dates, maintaining accurate records, and knowing when something needs to be escalated. You’ll own the administrative process from draft through execution, ensuring agreements move efficiently and accurately at every stage.

* Maintain an organized repository of executed agreements and supporting documentation
* Help establish and improve contract administration processes, templates, and approval workflows as the company grows

**Process \& Documentation Support**

* Maintain key operational trackers and documentation so leadership has an accurate, current view of priorities and outstanding actions
* Support documentation organization and process improvement across company systems
* Prepare materials, track action items, and drive follow\-up for the COO and VP of Operations
* Identify opportunities to bring greater structure and efficiency to recurring administrative and operational processes

**Vendor \& Operational Coordination**

* Coordinate vendor onboarding and related documentation, compliance, and administrative requirements

* Support coordination across Operations, Finance, and other teams to keep operational processes moving
* Provide ad hoc operational support as priorities shift and take on broader responsibilities as the Business Operations function grows

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3\+ years experience in business administration, contract administration, executive support, or a similar coordination focused role; exposure to contracts or vendor management
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy
* Strong organizational instincts and the discipline to keep processes, trackers, and documentation current without being asked
* Strong follow\-through and the ability to manage multiple open items without letting things fall through the cracks
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and good judgment about when to resolve something independently versus escalate
* Proficiency with tools such as DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office, with comfort learning new tools and systems
* Comfort using AI and other productivity tools to work efficiently and solve administrative problems

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Organized by nature, not just by job description
* A clear, proactive communicator who follows up without being chased
* Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out when there isn't an established process
* Trustworthy with sensitive information
* Excited to grow the scope of a role as the company scales, rather than needing it fully defined on day one

**Why You'll Love It Here**
---------------------------

* Help build the processes and infrastructure that will support Observable Space as we scale

**Competitive Compensation** – A salary package aligned with industry standards and your experience.

**Equity Opportunities** – Take part in our success with stock options.

**Flexible Work Environment** – Enjoy working from our office or in a hybrid work setup with the flexibility to work remotely part of the week. We require a minimum of 3 days per week in our office to support collaboration and team culture. (LA Office only)

**Unlimited PTO** (exempt only) – Tak

Field Operations Leadership Support

* Partner with field leadership to ensure alignment with operational standards and project execution priorities
* Organize and document project kickoff meetings for upcoming projects

  

  

Project Setup \& Systems Management


* Review and approve new project entries within JRM systems to ensure complete and accurate setup

* Enter and maintain project team changes within Project Creator, as directed

Procore Administration

Field Compliance \& Reporting


* Review weekly superintendent compliance with JRM operational standards, including:
	+ Daily logs
	+ Subcontractor meeting minutes
	+ Open and hot items lists
	+ Look\-ahead schedules
	+ Dumpster tickets
	+ OSR logs
* Report deficiencies and trends to the Director of Field Operations and Director of Project Management

  

  

Jobsite Operations \& Procurement

Project Closeout \& Coordination


* Support project teams in driving project completion and issuance of punch list completion letters to clients
* Monitor project closeout status and ensure required documentation is completed
* Serve as backup for project controls functions, including material orders, during absences

  

  

What Success Looks Like

* Strong field compliance and visibility into operational performance
* Seamless coordination between field teams, project teams, and leadership

At Matty’s Room, we create a playpen and play mat system that is as functional as it is beautiful—giving parents safe, joyful spaces without sacrificing style.

**About Us**
------------


Stic is modernizing out\-of\-home, one of advertising's oldest formats. Billboards and transit ads have always sold impressions on faith. Stic replaces faith by turning everyday vehicles into GPS\-tracked, mobile media. Brands get proof instead of best guesses. Drivers earn passive income on miles they're already driving.


Stic Vision is how it works. An edge AI device small enough to live inside a decal, streaming informative analytics with no vehicle\-level integration required.


The global out\-of\-home advertising market is worth roughly $40 billion a year. Stic is building the measurement layer that legacy OOH never had.


Stic is trusted by brands like TikTok, Dunkin Donuts, e.l.f., and PacSun. The traction is already showing up in results: a SXSW campaign for TikTok Radio put 44 vehicles on the road in Austin and generated 3\.9 million tracked impressions. That's real, revenue\-generating proof in a category still mostly sold on assumptions.


Stic is lean by design. People joining now build the playbook rather than inheriting one. This means fast execution, without the layers of process that slow down bigger companies.

**About You**


As our founding marketer, you'll own Instagram, LinkedIn, and other social platforms end\-to\-end. You will script, shoot, edit, and publish three to four posts a week, at least two of them video. The stories are already out there: drivers earning on routes they were driving anyway, wrapped cars that help brands reach their target audience, and campaigns with heat mapping that shows brands exactly where their ad traveled.


This is a true founding marketer seat. Your day\-to\-day will be primarily content and social. You’ll work directly with the founder to research advertising opportunities, coordinate podcast placements, manage campaigns in social media advertising platforms, and track results. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys both relationship\-driven media buying and data\-driven campaign optimization.

The position will start part\-time and is **likely to grow into a full\-time role** as the business and your responsibilities expand. Los Angeles based candidates preferred.

**What You’ll Do**

**Podcast Media Planning \& Buying**

* Research podcasts, hosts, networks, and audiences to identify opportunities aligned with client goals.
* Request proposals, evaluate inventory, compare CPMs, and assist with negotiating rates and added value.
* Help plan and purchase host\-read ads, baked\-in placements, dynamically inserted ads, and podcast sponsorships.
* Coordinate insertion orders, talking points, promo codes, tracking links, creative approvals, and launch schedules.
* Verify ad placements, monitor delivery, and follow up with partners on reporting and makegoods.

**Paid Social Campaign Management**

**Reporting \& Coordination**

**What We’re Looking For**

* Hands\-on familiarity with **Meta Ads Manager**, including campaign setup, reporting, and basic optimization.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* A willingness to ask questions, take initiative, and learn new platforms.
* Can think creatively and analytically.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience buying podcast ads or coordinating with podcast networks and sales representatives.

* Experience coordinating host read scripts, creator partnerships, or sponsored content.

**Why Camp Gravy**

* Work directly with the founder and receive hands on guidance.
* Build expertise as a marketing ninja.

* Take on more responsibility as your skills develop, with an anticipated path to full\-time employment as the business grows.

#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the West Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the West Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the West Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the West Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Hospitality experience required
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles

You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

jobs.description:
#### **Job Summary**



The **Assistant Project Manager** supports new ground\-up development and rehabilitation projects from site acquisition through construction and transition to operations. The position assists with project coordination, due diligence, entitlement activities, funding applications, budget tracking, scheduling, and project documentation.



The Assistant Project Manager works closely with the **Vice President of Acquisitions and Development, Project Managers, Construction Managers, Finance Department, Operations Department, and external stakeholders**, including architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, governmental agencies, and real estate professionals. This position requires periodic travel to project sites, meetings, public agencies, conferences, and other business\-related locations.

  


#### **Key Responsibilities**


##### **Site Acquisition \& Due Diligence**


* Coordinate the acquisition of land, existing buildings, and property portfolios for development and acquisition opportunities.
* Assist with assigned acquisition due diligence activities and coordinate the collection of required project information and documentation.
* Assist with the preparation, review, and tracking of due diligence reports, studies, and consultant deliverables.
* Assist with entitlement, permitting, and internal approval processes.
* Maintain project files and due diligence records in accordance with company standards.

##### **Entitlements, Permitting \& Project Oversight**


* Support entitlement and permitting activities and assist with obtaining required approvals from governmental agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Assist and coordinate with documentation regarding developing, analyzing, and maintaining project budgets, schedules, and project tracking reports.
* Assist in monitoring project performance against approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality objectives and report findings to project leadership.
* Assist with documentation for budget review, schedule variances corrective action.
* Assist in monitoring construction progress and communicate potential issues affecting project costs, schedules, quality, or completion to project leadership.
* Supports review of change orders and Requests for Information (RFIs) within established guidelines.
* Assist with billing applications and draw requests for completeness.
* Coordinate easements, permits, utility requirements, and other project\-related activities.
* Coordinate with the tracking of project milestones and assist with preparation of status reports for management.

##### **Project Funding**


* Assist with preparing applications and supporting documentation for Low\-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), HUD financing programs, grants, and other project funding sources.
* Collaborate with the Finance Department regarding project funding applications, financing requirements, and supporting documentation.
* Assist with due diligence required for financing, equity investment, loan closings, and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain organized records of funding applications, commitments, and compliance\-related documentation.

##### **Travel**


* Travel to project sites, municipal offices, meetings, public hearings, conferences, and other locations as required.
* Attends professional conferences, industry events, and training opportunities as assigned.

##### **Transition to Operations**


* Coordinate with the Operations Department regarding project closeout activities and post\-construction matters.
* Assist with the transition of completed projects from construction to lease\-up and ongoing property operations.
* Coordinates and assist with the collection and transfer of project records, warranties, permits, operating manuals, and related documentation.


**Administrative \& Reporting Responsibilities**


* Assist with preparation of correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting materials, and project\-related documentation.
* Coordinate project tracking tools, schedules, development files, and reporting systems.
* Attend project meetings and prepare follow\-up notes and action item summaries as requested.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

  


#### **Education \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Public Administration, Urban Planning, Real Estate Development, Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two (2\) to three (3\) years of relevant experience in affordable housing development, LIHTC, project management, construction, real estate development, community development, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of LIHTC, HUD financing programs, affordable housing development processes, and project funding structures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.
* Ability to analyze budgets, schedules, project documentation, and variances and provide recommendations to project leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, including public agencies, consultants, contractors, brokers, property owners, and internal departments.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.

##### **TECHNICAL SKILLS**


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Ability to create, maintain, and analyze project tracking spreadsheets and reports.
* Experience using project management, document management, or collaboration software preferred.
* Ability to learn and utilize company software systems and technology tools.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Certified associate in project management (CAPM) certification preferred or ability to obtain certification within the first year of employmen

This role takes a solutions\-based approach to account management, particularly in data center industries with high potential for cross\-business collaboration. Your focus will be on identifying opportunities to deliver comprehensive solutions by leveraging ABB’s broad portfolio through strategic alignment across multiple divisions.

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Drive new business growth** by exceeding sales targets and developing profitable opportunities in the data center sector.
* **Manage key accounts** across all product lines, including forecasting, issue resolution, and positioning ABB as a preferred vendor for motors and drives (VFDs).

* **Partner with Product Managers** to deliver training, seminars, and promotional events for internal teams, channel partners, consultants, and end\-users.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering Preferred) with minimum 5 years of experience in data centers, motors, drives (VFD’s) for cooling systems, power solutions and grid stability products.
* Strong background in consultative technical sales with long sales cycles (\>12 months).
* Willing to travel up to 60% (domestic and occasional international).

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Executive Assistant

**Reports to:** CEO

**Education Preferred (Not Required):** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education and experience

**Experience Required:** Minimum of 3 years of administration or related experience (non\-profit experience preferred)

**Position is:** Non\-Exempt, Full Time (30\-38 hours/week)

**Salary Range:** $25\.00 \- $28\.00/hr.

**About Families Forward**

At Families Forward, we are dedicated to preventing and ending family homelessness and strengthening community wellbeing across Orange County. Since 1984, our nonprofit organization has provided compassionate support that empowers families to achieve lasting stability and self\-sufficiency through housing programs, essential services like our food pantry and career counseling, and meaningful resources that nurture resilience and hope. Guided by our core values of dignity, empowerment, accountability, community spirit, and hope, we strive to create an environment where families can thrive and where every team member feels inspired, valued, and equipped to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others. We believe in fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace where passion for service meets purpose\-driven work. Join us in building stronger families and a stronger community.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and compassionate Executive Assistant to support the CEO and leadership team. This role is essential in helping the organization operate efficiently and strategically at the executive level. This role requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and a passion for supporting mission\-driven work. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to the values of our organization. This position plays a central role in facilitating smooth operations, effective internal communication, and a positive workplace culture.

**Essential Job Duties:**

**CEO and Executive Leadership Support (45% of time spent):**

* Provide direct administrative support to the CEO, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating travel.
* Provide administrative support to the Executive Leadership team as needed, including scheduling calendars and project coordination, document preparation, and logistics for strategic initiatives.
* Assist with maintaining agency\-wide organizational calendars and timelines for events, reports, and meetings.
* Prepare and edit correspondence, presentations, board materials, and internal documents.
* Support CEO in donor stewardship and development activities, including event coordination and tracking communications.
* Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate cultural humility when working with sensitive information related to clients and operations.
* Conduct research and support strategic initiatives at the request of the CEO.

**Board Administration (30% of time spent):**

* Primary interface with the Board of Directors.
* Coordinate logistics for board of directors and committee meetings: prepare agendas, compile meeting packets, set\-up meetings, take minutes, and track follow\-up actions.
* Maintain Board rosters and attendance.
* Facilitate the Board orientations and new member manuals.
* Support Board of Directors special events.
* Organize and maintain board related files and records in SharePoint.

**Admin and HR Support (15% of time spent):**

* Support with administrative tasks and functions including opening daily mail, managing Families Forward info email inbox, assisting with managing all staff directory/phone lists, and more.
* Support HR functions as needed, including scheduling interviews and coordinating onboarding logistics for new staff.
* Assist with processing invoices, check requests, and coding expense reimbursements in coordination with the Finance team.
* Track receipts and reconcile credit card transactions for the CEO and executive leadership team.
* Assist with tracking and updating organizational policies, procedures, and administrative documents.

**Employee Engagement Support (10% of time spent):**

* Help plan and coordinate all\-staff meetings, retreats, appreciation events, and wellness initiatives.
* Support efforts to foster a strong, inclusive organizational culture by gathering staff feedback, assisting with engagement surveys, and helping implement morale\-boosting activities.
* Serve as a trusted partner to staff across departments to promote collaboration and ensure clear communication between leadership and team members.

Special Projects/Other Duties as Assigned

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Exceptional communication, writing, and editing skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Zoom, and project management tools.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and handle sensitive information with integrity.
* Deep commitment to the mission of ending homelessness and supporting underserved populations.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships.
* Exercise good judgement in a variety of situations.
* Flexible hours for early meetings as well as occasional responsibilities on the weekends or in the evening.
* Ability to occasionally lift or carry 25 pounds.
* Valid California Driver License and State Mandated Vehicle Insurance.

**What You Need to Be Successful in This Role**

* You stay a step ahead of the CEO and leadership team by anticipating needs, managing details, and keeping schedules, meetings, documents, travel, and follow\-up items moving smoothly.
* You bring order to complexity by balancing competing priorities, tracking deadlines, and making sure important tasks, decisions, and communications do not fall through the cracks.
* You communicate with clarity, professionalism, and warmth whether you are preparing materials, drafting correspondence, coordinating with staff, or serving as a point of contact for board members and extern

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator

**Position Summary:**

The Construction Project Coordinator oversees the defining scope, planning, implementation, tracking and completion/evaluation of projects which have a beginning, an end and specified deliverables. Must be able to reconcile construction activities and manage scope change during project and complete project within designated time frame and on budget.

Construction Project Coordinator must take ownership of projects they are assigned.

**Job Duties/Responsibilities:**

1\. Hit Target Revenue provided

2\. Contacting customers for projects once the pre\-construction phase is complete.

3\. Customer point of contact for on\-site activities

4\. Responsible for overall project success – being on time and under budget

5\. Responsible for managing and delegating to Project Coordinator Assistants as needed

6\. During construction phase, track and coordinate materials, schedule, timelines and budget and if necessary RFI log

7\. Manage sub\-contractors on current projects for construction activities

8\. Schedule projects with all subcontractors and customers.

a. To do so, three things must be accomplished, in order:

i. Design drawings must be completed and approved by client

ii. Materials from vendors must have delivery date finalized

iii. Confirmation in writing from the client that onsite date is acceptable

9\. Coordinating with Design Department to obtain all the necessary documentation for projects during construction phase

10\. Provide regular updates to Management as requested

11\. Responsible for receiving and inventory of the material as the first step of construction phase. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required.

12\. Control Job Tickets and what is in job tickets

13\. Coordinating with Project Coordinator Assistants as to Field Tech availability and forecasting field techs to projects

14\. Create Hot Sheets for items that need to be addressed once the main body of work is completed and there are still minor things to complete

15\. Travel to jobsite or offsite coordination meetings as required with Operations Manager, Supervisor, or Foreman

16\. First day of work walk the job site with field techs and Field Tech Manager or Foreman

17\. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required

18\. Other responsibilities and tasks as assigned or needed

19\. Responsible for creating and submitting Change Orders/Credit Memos during construction phase:

a. If client is requesting a change in scope, addition, or alternative solution

b. If on site conditions are not as specified in the project’s documentation

i. If questions arise from any of the above, report to Operations Manager for direction

ii. Change orders are to be submitted to Operations Manager for review/comment/approval

20\. Update clients daily for work completed that day and anticipated completion date for the rest of the work

21\. Responsible to maintain daily logs for onsite work

22\. Responsible for Forecasting all projects during the weekly forecasting meeting held Tuesdays

23\. Coordinating, setting up, and preparing for Weekly Huddles

24\. Assist in closing of city permits \- schedule final inspections with city department

25\. Responsible for closeouts of the project with closeout docs completed such as test reports, As\-built, OPOS, warranties, O\&M, MSDS sheets, project manuals, AI reports etc.

26\. Responsible for keeping project status updated on project management software

27\. Responsible for sending the weekly billing to pre\-construction project coordinator for ongoing projects

28\. Coordinate project coordinator visits (PCV) requests from design team

29\. Hold closeout documents meeting on Thursdays

30\. Responsible for responding to clients within 24 hours

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma (College or Business school desirable)
* A minimum of 2\-5 years of experience in construction project management.
* Direct experience in construction field operations, including site visits and supervision, is highly beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines.
* Proficiency in construction management software, scheduling tools, and project management software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with clients, contractors, and team members.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues promptly and efficiently.

**Physical Requirements**

This is primarily a sedentary office position, which requires the ability to occasionally bend, stoop, reach, lift, move and carry supplies and materials up to 40 lbs.

May also be required to physically attend off\-site meetings, gather site\-specific information and observations, and travel to multiple project locations.

**Qualification Requirements**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $26\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Are you able to perform these essential job functions with or without a reasonable accommodation?

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Specialist (Middle School Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach)**

**Salary:****$26\-$30 per hour, plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator**

**Status:****Full Time (30 hours/week); Non\-Exempt (Position ends 6/2/2027\)**

 **POSITION DESCRIPTION**


Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist (Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach) is responsible for providing academic tutoring, educational support and behavioral coaching to youth during the school day and in after school programs. The position is responsible for tutoring middle school aged students in core academic classes such as English, Math, Science, Social Studies, etc. The position may also support a variety of enrichment activities as needed.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide one\-on\-one and group academic tutoring in core subject areas and behavioral coaching to students.
* Collaborate and coordinate with school day teachers, counselors, and beacon staff to identify high needs students who need educational support.
* Provide 1:1 light case management to students who need social emotional learning and behavioral health support.
* Provide training and support to high school volunteer tutors as needed.
* Create incentive plans to encourage student engagement and retention.
* Develop and support a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for youth as needed.
* Support with outreach and marketing strategies to recruit and retain youth programs.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Work collaboratively with the school leadership team, community partners, and faculty to design and align programs to support the school’s goals for student development, academic achievement, social and emotional learning.
* Make contact with parents/caregivers in a professional and consistent manner to advise parents on youths' progress and challenges.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested by funders and supervisor.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields preferred plus 2 years of proven experience in youth development or experience in providing academic support.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with diverse youth and families is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cancer Immunotherapy Research & Clinical Translation Program
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join the Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation (CIRCT) Program within the Division of Hematology/Oncology.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager and/or the Principal Investigator (PI). The incumbent will coordinate the operations and data collection of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies (sponsored, cooperative group, and investigator\-initiated studies), depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; assist with training of Assistant CRCs help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; assist in maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.  

  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is a national leader in oncology research. The Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation program is a fast paced program with a broad portfolio of clinical trials. The mission of the UCSF HDFCC Oncology Program is to provide patients and their families with streamlined access to cutting\-edge cancer therapies, In addition to providing compassionate, patient\-centered care, our team of clinicians and researchers is dedicated to improving outcomes for all patients.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Familiarity with specimen processing, or demonstrated ability to learn specimen processing in a laboratory environment
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Ability to work across several different programs, reporting to 2\-3 different supervisors
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences.
* Exceptional database management experience and prior experience with various computer programs (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore.
* Experience with medical charts and electronic records
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day. May need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle. Ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of, or demonstrated ability to learn federal, state, and local research regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team oriented environment

Preferred Qualifications:


* Bachelor's degree with a major in science or related
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials and experience with Phase I\-III trials
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:



	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

We are looking for a friendly, outgoing, Japanese\-speaking team member to help us create food, cultural, fandom, gaming, and entertainment experiences in the Bay Area.

This is a hands\-on role that combines Japanese community and brand relationships, event coordination, hosting, food, games, fandom, and social media.

You will help communicate with Japanese brands and partners, coordinate community and fandom events, work with vendors and collaborators, interact with guests, and represent our company both in person and online.

Professional event or marketing experience is not required. We are especially interested in people who are personable, reliable, curious, and excited to learn.

Japanese Community \& Brand Relationships

* Help build and maintain relationships with Japanese brands and partners both locally and internationally
* Communicate with partners in Japanese through email, messaging, and other channels

* Participate in short\-form videos, interviews, demonstrations, and event content

Required Qualifications

* Strong Japanese reading and writing ability
* Able to communicate comfortably in English
* Friendly, approachable, and comfortable talking with new people

* Reliable and responsible

*Proudly serving our San Francisco Bay Area communities since 1986, Mollie Stone’s Markets is a local, family\-owned grocery store chain. With over 38 years of exemplary performance, Mollie Stone’s Markets continues to make a difference in people’s lives through food. We succeed in the industry by ensuring we deliver a large variety of exciting and quality products in an attractive and positive environment. Our roots remain in healthy, natural and specialty foods. Mollie Stone’s Buyers work closely with local producers around the greater Bay Area to bring high quality products to every aisle. Our goal is to surprise and delight our customers.*

*We pride ourselves on being an employer of choice, and we are proud to offer competitive wages, paid time off, physical and mental health benefits, 401(k) or pension plan, as well as career training programs through our professional partnerships. As a local, family owned and operated business, we are grateful to our customers as they support our vision, which allows us to care for our employees by making a difference in their l**ives.*

***About the Role:***


The Lead Merchandising \& Procurement Coordinator reports directly to the Senior Procurement Director and supports merchandising and procurement initiatives across all Mollie Stone's Markets locations. This hybrid role combines hands\-on store merchandising, procurement support, administrative responsibilities, vendor program coordination, and data analysis.


This is a highly hands\-on position requiring regular travel between store locations. The role works closely with store teams to support execution and maintain strong merchandising standards.


The role requires initiative, organization, sound judgment, and follow\-through while maintaining alignment with the direction and priorities established by the Senior Procurement Director.


The ideal candidate is resourceful, adaptable, comfortable solving problems, and able to create practical solutions while remaining open to feedback and changing business priorities.

***Merchandising \& Store Support***

* Serve as a lead resource for merchandising initiatives and personally execute merchandising projects in stores.
* Perform hands\-on merchandising.
* Work alongside store teams to execute merchandising initiatives and provide support as needed.
* Ensure merchandising and promotional initiatives are executed according to company standards and objectives.
* Conduct regular store visits to merchandise, evaluate execution, identify opportunities, and recommend improvements.
* Partner with Store Operations and Marketing on merchandising and promotional initiatives.
* Develop practical merchandising solutions when formal planograms, templates, or established processes are not available.

***Procurement \& Administrative Support:***

  



* Provide operational and administrative support to the Senior Procurement Director.
* Support department priorities, special projects, and follow\-up on key initiatives.
* Pull, organize, and analyze sales movement reports, performance reports, and other operational data.
* Assist with product maintenance, pricing updates, data entry, and other procurement\-related administrative functions.
* Support reporting and other computer\-based tasks necessary to the department.

***Vendor and Store Support:***

  

* Serve as the primary administrator for the company's product demonstration program, including vendor communication, scheduling, and program coordination.
* Support Senior Procurement Director andstore teams with ordering questions, product setup, pricing discrepancies, and other operational issues.
* Coordinate vendor samples and maintain the department sample library.
* Assist with vendor meetings, product reviews, and store walkthroughs.
* Support invoice verification, claims, pricing reviews, and vendor follow\-up.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Store Operations, vendors, and internal teams to support company initiatives.

***Operational Support:***

  

* Implement new merchandising and procurement initiatives.
* Develop practical solutions and improve workflows.
* Maintain accurate product, pricing, and purchasing information as needed.
* Assist with reports and tracking key business information.
* Follow through on assigned projects and initiatives.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Golden State Dermatology is a physician\-led and owned dermatology group rapidly expanding across California. We are a leading medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology group specializing in skin, hair, and nail conditions, Mohs micrographic surgery for the treatment of skin cancer, surgical and non\-surgical cosmetic skincare, anti\-aging, body contouring, and plastic surgery.

  

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the conduct of clinical trials under the direction of the Principal Investigator and research leadership. This position is responsible for coordinating assigned studies and ensuring study activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with study protocols, ICH\-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and institutional requirements.

  

The Coordinator works closely with study participants, investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other research staff. Responsibilities include study start\-up and regulatory activities, participant recruitment and study visits, source documentation and EDC entry, safety reporting, study supply management, monitoring visit preparation, and study close\-out.

  

This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication, and problem\-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities and proactively identify and escalate study\-related issues. Frequent travel to the Walnut Creek study site is required.

 **Essential Responsibilities**  

**Study Start\-Up \& Regulatory**

* Support study feasibility and start\-up activities.
* Review study protocols and study materials to understand operational requirements.
* Prepare and maintain regulatory documents, including IRB submissions, amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Maintain regulatory binders and essential study documents.
* Complete study\-specific training and maintain required training documentation.
* Assist with preparation for site initiation visits, monitoring visits, sponsor visits, audits, and inspections.
* Perform study activities in accordance with ICH\-GCP, FDA regulations, study protocols, and applicable institutional requirements.

 **Study Conduct \& Coordination**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities for assigned clinical studies.
* Communicate with investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other study personnel regarding assigned study activities.
* Review and stay current on sponsor and CRO communications regarding study updates, including protocol amendments, revised regulatory documents, updated study materials, and changes to study procedures or requirements.
* Schedule and conduct study visits according to protocol.
* Ensure study procedures are completed accurately and within required timelines.
* Track study milestones, outstanding items, and required follow\-up.
* Identify study issues, delays, or potential protocol concerns and escalate them promptly.
* Receive, organize, and maintain study supplies, devices, and equipment.
* Process and ship laboratory specimens and other study materials according to protocol requirements.

 **Subject Management**

* Support participant recruitment, prescreening, screening, enrollment, and retention.
* Obtain and document informed consent when appropriately delegated by the Principal Investigator.
* Coordinate participant visits and study\-related procedures.
* Maintain communication with participants regarding study visits and requirements.
* Protect participant rights, safety, privacy, and confidentiality.
* Document protocol deviations and assist with required follow\-up and corrective actions.
* Escort participants to local approved study sites (phlebotomy and radiology) when required.

 **Data \& Documentation**

* Complete accurate and timely source documentation.
* Enter study data into electronic data capture (EDC) systems within required timelines.
* Review study data and documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Respond to and resolve data queries promptly.
* Maintain organized study files and documentation suitable for sponsor monitoring and regulatory review.
* Ensure study documentation supports protocol and regulatory requirements.

 **Safety \& Quality**

* Identify and document adverse events and serious adverse events and promptly escalate them to the Principal Investigator.
* Complete required safety reporting to sponsors and IRBs according to applicable procedures and timelines.
* Review assigned study work for completeness, accuracy, and protocol compliance.
* Identify documentation or process discrepancies and assist with their resolution.
* Participate in corrective and preventive actions when applicable.

 **Monitoring \& Sponsor Coordination**

* Prepare study records and materials for monitoring visits.
* Participate in sponsor and CRO monitoring visits.
* Respond to monitor requests and follow up on action items within required timelines.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with sponsors, CROs, monitors, and study personnel.
* Escalate unresolved sponsor, operational, or regulatory issues to research leadership or the Principal Investigator.

 **Financial \& Administrative Support**

* Maintain accurate records of participant visits, study activities, and participant stipends.
* Prepare and submit invoices to sponsors/CROs for billable study activities in accordance with study budgets and contracts.
* Track sponsor payments and assist with payment reconciliation, including identifying and following up on outstanding or discrepant payments.
* Maintain documentation necessary to support study billing and financial reconciliation.

 **Study Close\-Out**

* Assist with study close\-out activities.
* Resolve outstanding documentation and data items before study closure.
* Ensure study records are complete and organized for appropriate archiving.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results;; assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


The CRC is being hired to support a large NIH funded research study to use real\-time monitoring of alcohol use as the gold standard to determine the best cutoff for an alcohol biomarker called phosphatidylethanol (PEth), that is found in blood tests. The real\-time monitoring will be using a wrist\-worn biosensor and daily cell\-phone based surveys over a 28\-day study period. The CRC will conduct screening and enrolling study participants, scheduling study visits, and will conduct all participant facing procedures including gaining informed consent, training and supporting participants on the use of the technology associated with the study, conducting study surveys, performing finger\-pricks for blood spot collection, and conducting non\-invasive measurements of body composition such as height, weight, waist and hip measurements. The CRC will assist in development and maintaining protocols, conducting real\-time checks for data completeness and participant compliance, and will track and distribute study remuneration. The CRC will maintain study specimen tracking and oversee shipping for laboratory analysis. The CRC will report on participant recruitment and retention and may assist with regulatory issues such as IRB compliance and NIH progress reports.
  

  

**ABOUT DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE**  

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home\-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983\. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 36 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines  
* 

Preferred Qualifcations:


* Fluency in Spanish
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biological sciences or public health
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping non\- infectious substances
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:
	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long\-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. The full base pay range for this role is between $74,500 and $111,500\. This role will be paid on an hourly basis.


Our benefits include health, wellness, and financial programs that support employees through every stage of life.


Benefit highlights include:

Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, reliable, and affordable internet access around the world, fueling healthy competition in established markets and closing the digital divide wherever it persists. Our next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) platform delivers fiber\-class broadband at a fraction of the cost and deployment time of traditional options, and is already available to more than 20M homes and businesses globally.

* Travel to support events when necessary (roughly 4 times per year)
* Office presence required: at least three days per week

* A bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field

* Excellent organization and thorough project management, even under a time crunch
* Ability to roll with punches and excel in a fast\-paced environment
* Collaboration and superb communication, both written and verbal
* Diligent budget management and ROI analysis
* Solid understanding of social media (primarily LinkedIn, and also Facebook, X, Instagram and YouTube)

 **Bonus Points for****:**

* Graphic design experience
* Experience with Asana tool
* Telecom and broadband industry knowledge

 **What we offer:**  

**We don’t just build next\-gen wireless technology — we build people.**


 The salary range for this position is: $105,000 to $125,000


Compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to: skill set, years of experience and the employee’s geographic location.


Tarana provides competitive benefits to employees in this role, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401K match, flexible time off, and stock options.  

  

**Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity**.

**About Us**


Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R\&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game\-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com.
