jobs.description:
### **About Us**



Hively has been serving Alameda County families since 1976\. We support families through child care stipends and referrals, family resource navigation, parent education classes, and clinical mental health services. Our mission is to create meaningful connections with families and communities, ensuring access to resources every child in Alameda County needs to thrive. Our vision is to transform the lives of children and families to benefit all communities and ensure a promising future for generations to come.



If this resonates with you, we invite you to apply to join our team!



Hively’s presence around Alameda County is growing. Our Hive on Wheels (Mobile Resource Center) and tabling events accounted for more than 120 events in the last fiscal year. Our Marketing, Communications and Development Team is ready to welcome a new team member to support our outreach, community engagement and communications efforts


### **Position Overview**



Are you passionate about making a difference in your community, connecting with people, building relationships and creating welcoming spaces for families and child care providers? This role is part of our Marketing, Communications and Development team. It’s mainly an external facing role to represent Hively at community events, supporting the Hive on Wheels program, and community engagement work. In this role, you'll be the friendly face of Hively, being an active part of our community events that are engaging, well\-organized, and welcoming for families, children and other community stakeholders.


**Please note that many of our events occur in the evenings and/or on weekends, so the schedule for this role will often vary, with work frequently performed outside of normal business hours (flex hours are planned).**

  



### **What You'll Do**


* **Coordinate Event Logistics:** Manage all aspects of Hive on Wheels and tabling events, from liaising with host organizations to promoting events and handling pre\- and post\-event checklists.
* **Research and secure events across Alameda county:** Find mission aligned events that will allow us to meet outreach and community engagement goals.
* **Manage Supplies:** Ensure the van is fully stocked with essential consumables (diapers, clothing, print materials). You'll also be responsible for packing up and recharging electronics after each event.
* **Setup and Breakdown:** Efficiently set up and take down all event materials, displays, and activities.
* **Engage with the Community:** Greet families, collect survey responses, distribute materials, and answer questions about Hively's services with warmth and professionalism.
* **Facilitate Activities:** Lead or assist with fun, kid\-friendly activities. Be our Hively Bee Mascot when needed.
* **Build Relationships:** Proactively identify and connect with community leaders and partners at events, and share introductions with senior leadership following events.
* **Capture and Share Content:** Take photos and videos at events and post to social media following our guidelines.
* **Support Reporting:** Assist with post\-event reporting, including data entry, creating quantitative reports, and sharing qualitative stories from events.
* **Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders:** Work closely with Hively staff, volunteers, and partner organizations.
* **Communications Support (20%):** Assist with a variety of organizational needs including WordPress updates, Canva designs, printing, swag orders and more.
* **Online Outreach (10%):** Update and maintain online platforms such as: Facebook groups, Instagram and other platforms.
### **What You'll Bring**


* **A Passion for Community:** You have an interest in community engagement, social services, or early childhood education.
* **Previous Experience:** 2\+ years of work experience in event planning and execution, community engagement, communications or marketing. Experience working with children is also a plus.
* **Excellent Communication Skills:** You're comfortable talking to people and building rapport quickly.
* **Highly Organized:** You're dependable and detail\-oriented with an eye for design aesthetic; you are able to manage multiple tasks at once.
* **Flexibility and Adaptability:** You're comfortable working in a mobile, outdoor setting with a variable schedule.
* **Physical Requirements:** You're able to lift up to 30 lbs and assist with event setup and breakdown.
* **Driving Experience:** You have a valid driver’s license, a clean driving record, and are comfortable driving a 22\-foot Ford Transit Van.
* **Bilingual Skills (Spanish):** **Spanish proficiency is required.**
* **Experience with Children:** You enjoy working with children and are willing to serve as the Hively Bee Mascot would be a plus.

### **What you will learn:**


* Event planning and coordination
* Community outreach and engagement strategies
* Exposure to early childhood and family support services
* Networking with local partners
* WordPress, Canva, HubSpot and other design and marketing tools.

At Weave, our mission is to evolve how therapeutic knowledge is captured, transformed, and communicated throughout drug development. We do this by equipping human experts with AI instruments to enable drugs to be brought to patients as rapidly, safely, and inexpensively as possible.



The Weave Platform streamlines regulatory workflows from start to finish by intelligently, creatively, and effectively infusing every step with AI. Together with our customers, Weave is designing and building the AI workbench for the entire therapeutic lifecycle.

**The Role \& Your Mission**
============================



Weave is looking for a resourceful, relationship\-driven **Events \& Field Marketing Manager** to turn a busy event calendar into a system that generates demand, trust, and ongoing relationships with the regulatory leaders we sell to. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you'll own the calendar, the pipeline target attached to it, and a repeatable pre\- and post\-event motion that turns badge scans into meetings and meetings into pipeline. Logistics run through a vendor bench you will manage and shape.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Own the annual marketing events calendar and budget allocation, deciding which events we attend, at what tier, and why.
* Carry a pipeline target for every event. You'll define what a successful event looks like before it happens and report against it afterward.
* Build and run a repeatable pre\- and post\-event motion: account targeting, meeting\-setting with AEs, on\-site capture, and follow\-up that dovetails with the rest of our marketing campaigns and automations.
* Build and manage our bench of logistics vendors and contractors.
* Own the webinar program end to end, from topic selection through to follow\-up conversion.
* Partner with Product Marketing on booth narrative, demo strategy, and speaking submissions.
* Partner with RevOps on clean data capture and lead flow so event\-sourced pipeline is attributable.
* Partner with the Head of Marketing to create a community program strategy for 2027, providing peer\-to\-peer learning opportunities for the users and buyers we serve.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================


* 4\-7 years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or conference and association program management.
* **Proven at volume.** You've run 15\+ events a year, or a program of comparable complexity. We're less interested in one flawless flagship than in evidence you can hold many moving pieces without dropping them.
* **Vendor and budget management experience.** You've negotiated, you've held people to deadlines, you've ended contracts that weren't working.
* **Commercial instinct.** You think in pipeline, not attendance. If you've come from the association or conference\-organizer side and haven't formally carried a pipeline number, tell us — we care that you want to and can think that way, not that it's already on your résumé.
* **Experience using events to nurture ongoing relationships**. A user group, an advisory board, a recurring roundtable, a community that outlived the conference that started it.
* **Strong writing skills.** You'll be drafting invitations, briefs, and follow\-ups that go to senior stakeholders within and outside Weave.
* Preferred, not required: experience marketing to or working within life sciences, pharma, biotech, or another regulated industry.
* Willingness to travel roughly 25–40%, concentrated around the conference calendar.

**What We Offer**
=================


 The opportunity to work at a modern, cutting\-edge healthcare technology company devoted to meaningful positive impact on human life. Collaboration, velocity, and customer obsession are our baseline, demonstrations of craftsmanship and ROI are celebrated.



 Competitive salary ($130,000 \- $160,000\) plus eligibility for company performance bonus and equity packages.

 Career development opportunities within a company entering a growth phase.



 Hybrid in San Francisco with in\-office days Tues/Wed/Thurs and flexibility to work remote Mon/Fri.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.


We design workflow software and AI\-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.


We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F\-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------


Snapdocs is the trusted infrastructure for high\-stakes transactions. We started in mortgage, where trust is not assumed, the work is fragmented across many parties, and the cost of mistakes is real \- and are bringing that same standard of trust to other markets.


Years of automating the hardest tasks gave us something more foundational than workflow software: an AI\-native platform that makes complex work easy to complete, hard to get wrong, and built to withstand scrutiny over time.


Field marketing turns that promise into tangible presence and relationships in the market by owning the programs that put Snapdocs in front of the right audiences, in the right settings, for the right reasons. You’ll turn conferences, executive programs, customer gatherings, partner activations, and account\-based programs into credible brand experiences, tight relationships, and measurable commercial impact.

**The role**
------------


This is a hands\-on field marketing role with broad ownership. You’ll help shape where and why Snapdocs shows up, choose the programs most relevant to our audiences and business priorities, manage the details that make those programs work, and connect every program to coordinated Sales and Marketing follow\-up.


Events are the primary channel, but field marketing is broader than event execution. It also includes regional programs, executive presence, customer and prospect engagement, partner programs, and account\-based plays across Snapdocs’ markets. You’ll help make our mission tangible by creating experiences that simplify complexity, build trust, and move the right relationships forward.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* Take ownership of a strong, existing events lineup for mortgage, primarily geared towards sales in\-person meetings, and then building the playbook for expanding event presence on\-stage, in new thought\-leadership forums and through field motions.
* Strategize a new non\-real\-estate events plan, including identifying strategic event and field motions in priority adjacent industries, designed to establish credibility, develop relationships, and create pipeline in those markets.
* Unify existing and new vertical field marketing strategies into a tiered event strategy across industry, partner, customer, and executive programs.
* Decide the right level of presence for each program, from attendance and executive meetings to sponsorships, booths, speaking opportunities, roundtables, dinners, and roadshows.
* Run event programs end to end: goals, budget, registrations, vendors, booth and materials, attendee lists, on\-site execution, and follow\-up.
* Partner with Lender and Settlement Sales to connect event plans to target accounts, meetings, and next steps, ensuring event participation converts into a repeatable pipeline and revenue motion, strengthens Snapdocs’ credibility across the mortgage ecosystem and new verticals, and builds executive, partner, and customer relationships that support growth
* Work with Revenue Marketing on pre\-event outreach, in\-event signal capture, and post\-event follow\-up, including help with prospecting, messaging and social engagement.
* Use HubSpot as the system of record for event planning, lists, activity tracking, and handoffs, with Salesforce and Slack connected where needed.
* Track cost per attendee, meetings booked, meeting follow\-up, qualified opportunities, pipeline impact, and 30\-day post\-event ROI. Use what you learn to make sharper investment calls.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4\+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or go\-to\-market marketing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, financial services, or a similarly complex industry.
* A track record of owning events or field programs that contributed to qualified meetings, pipeline, customer relationships, or revenue.
* Excellent project management. You keep many workstreams moving, write clear next steps, and make it obvious who owns what and when.
* Strong judgment on event investment. You can assess attendee lists, audience fit, sponsorship value, sales goals, cost, and expected return before recommending a program.
* Experience working closely with sales, customers, partners, vendors, and executives. You make it easy for others to do their part and keep things from falling through the cracks.
* Comfort learning and operating marketing automation, CRM, lead capture, or event systems. Direct HubSpot experience is a plus.
* Experience working on a lean marketing team with broad ownership, from deciding where to invest to making sure the room is ready.
* Ability to travel to industry events, customer programs, and executive gatherings. Travel will be dependent on the specific event needs, but this role is not required to be at every event, instead using good judgment and clear evaluation of need to determine on\-site presence levels.

**AI proficiency at Snapdocs**
------------------------------


AI proficiency is a core expectation at Snapdocs. We expect you to use AI as part of your day\-to\-day work, with real judgment about where it helps and where you need to check the output.

jobs.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

### **About the Role**


As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest\-velocity, highest\-volume post\-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands\-on customer impact \- driving excellence in post\-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast\-moving book of accounts.


This is a revenue\-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first \- more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high\-volume book of business.
* Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate \- building a team culture where expansions and cross\-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota\-carrying sales function.
* Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
* Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
* Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI\-powered approaches to their work.
* Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
* Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post\-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high\-volume, transactional or corporate\-segment books of business.
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
* 2\+ years of direct people leadership experience \- managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high\-performance, feedback\-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
* Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
* Strong player\-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
* Expertise in post\-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high\-volume, scaled motion.

Haines (haines.com) is a vital San Francisco art gallery known for its compelling exhibitions and roster of international artists. Haines is seeking a talented, Bay Area\-based Social Media and Community Manager to foster visibility and engagement via its social channels.

The Social Media and Community Manager is an hourly\-based, contractor position requiring approximately 8\-10 hours / week, including weekly Zoom meetings. Exact hours will fluctuate depending on gallery activity and needs. Much of the work can be done remotely, but the Social Media and Community Manager is expected to attend and capture relevant gallery / art events, as well as traveling to gallery / artists studios to shoot videos.

Salary: $30\-35 per hour, depending on experience.

**Social Handles**  
IG:  
FB:  
LinkedIn (less active):

**SCOPE OF WORK**

**Strategy and Campaign Development**  
Plan and carry out social media campaigns around Haines Gallery’s exhibitions, artists, events, and other priorities, with the goal of increasing visibility and engagement.

**Content Creation and Publishing**  
Produce, edit, schedule, and publish engaging, platform\-native content across the gallery’s active social channels, primarily Instagram and Facebook, maintaining a consistent posting cadence across all active platforms. Content should include compelling short\-form video, such as Reels featuring artists, studio visits, and exhibition walk\-throughs, as well as other original content. Develop a mix of timely and evergreen content to sustain engagement when needed.

Maintain a thoughtful, informed voice consistent with the gallery’s identity, with particular attention to accuracy in references to artists, artworks, and exhibitions. Assess opportunities to expand Haines Gallery’s presence on TikTok and other emerging platforms.

**Community Engagement and Audience Growth**  
Actively engage with Haines Gallery’s audiences and the broader Bay Area and international art communities, identifying opportunities for partnership, cross\-promotion, and audience growth. Cultivate engaged members of the gallery’s network who can help amplify exhibitions, artists, and programs.

Look for opportunities to reshare audience and partner content, and use platform features such as collaborative posts and event listings where they can help extend reach. Develop sharing kits when useful and encourage artists, institutions, and other participants to amplify campaigns through their own channels.

Respond to comments and messages, forwarding sales\-related inquiries to gallery staff for follow\-up.

Rather than treating Haines Gallery’s accounts as a one\-way broadcast channel, stay attuned to what is happening online around the gallery, its artists, and the broader art community. Curate appropriate external content for resharing, including relevant arts\-related content beyond the gallery’s own artists and exhibitions.

**Analytics and Reporting**  
Track social media performance across platforms, including audience growth, engagement, reach, and campaign effectiveness. Prepare and present periodic reports on key trends and insights, and make recommendations to gallery leadership to refine strategy and improve campaign performance.

Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.

* Paid Time Off and Holidays

A reasonable estimate of total compensation for this role ranges between $70,304 \- $150,000/Year and is a combination of base salary plus earned commissions. The range takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, performance, and other business and organization needs. Please note, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decision are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each decision.

About the Role

Otium Nails \& Lashes Cafe Lounge is seeking a creative, reliable, and AI\-savvy Part\-Time Social Media \& Digital Marketing Coordinator to grow our online presence and help turn social media attention into appointments and sales.

This is a hybrid, part\-time W\-2 position averaging 10–20 hours per week, depending on content volume and campaign needs. Most work is remote, with one 2–3 hour in\-store content session per month at our Brooklyn salon. Pay is $25–$30 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio.

Our nail artists capture fresh manicure content each day. You will select, edit, organize, and turn that raw material into polished content for Instagram and TikTok while also supporting influencer partnerships, paid advertising, website updates, and practical marketing campaigns.

* Independently manage the salon’s official Instagram and TikTok accounts
* Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages during agreed working hours, and route appointment changes or sensitive customer issues to salon staff
* Create and maintain a consistent content calendar
* Edit and repurpose daily nail photos and vertical videos supplied by our nail artists
* Use AI tools for retouching, filters, color correction, captions, subtitles, creative variations, and workflow efficiency
* Write natural, engaging English captions for a U.S. audience
* Attend one monthly in\-store session to photograph the salon, team, promotions, and evergreen brand content

* Proactively research and contact relevant NYC beauty, nail, fashion, and lifestyle influencers

* Create or update basic website pages and landing pages using AI and no\-code tools such as Wix, Squarespace, or similar platforms
* Propose practical promotions and marketing ideas

All advertising budgets, influencer payments, discounts, and major campaign decisions require owner approval in advance.

* Strong visual taste and attention to detail

Founded on the Upper East Side of New York City by brothers Jay and Kevin McLaughlin, J.McLaughlin was built on a simple idea: great style feels personal.


From a single neighborhood shop to nearly 200 stores nationwide, we have always believed in being local and loyal—to our customers, our communities, and one another. Today, nearly 1,000 employees bring the brand to life across the country, from Maine to Maui.


For over 20 years, our corporate home has been in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, where creativity, craftsmanship, and collaboration continue to shape our next chapter.


Giving back is part of who we are. We support the communities we serve through local partnerships, charitable initiatives, and a belief that businesses should leave places better than they found them.

**Overview**


We are seeking a Logistics Coordinator to join our Product Development and Supply Chain team, reporting to our Director of Production. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating purchase orders and inbound logistics activities from PO issuance through delivery of goods to the warehouse. This role will work closely with internal teams, vendors, freight forwarders, and warehouse partners to ensure timely and accurate shipment execution.


This position is primarily based in our Greenpoint, Brooklyn office and follows a hybrid schedule, dependent on role and business needs.

**About the role**

* Issue Purchase Orders and ensure all PO information is accurate and complete.
* Maintain and update POs, including changes to quantities, delivery dates, shipping details, and other key information.
* Work closely with freight forwarders to coordinate vessel bookings and shipment schedules.
* Review and approve vessel bookings to ensure alignment with required delivery timelines.
* Coordinate consolidation of goods across vendors and Purchase Orders to support efficient shipments.
* Monitor shipment status and key milestones from cargo readiness through vessel departure and final delivery.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders and warehouse teams to ensure timely delivery of goods into the warehouse.
* Maintain accurate PO, shipment, and delivery information in company systems.
* Maintain and publish transit lead\-time charts by country and port to support Production planning.
* Report shipment delays and potential delivery risks to the Production team on a weekly basis.
* Calculate and publish freight costs by product category and region to support costing, budgeting, and freight cost management.
* Proactively identify, communicate, and escalate potential shipment delays or logistics issues.
* Partner with Sourcing, Production, vendors, forwarders, and warehouse teams to ensure alignment on order and delivery status.

**What we are looking for**


Skills \& Requirements:

* 2\-4 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, import/export, or purchase order management.

* Strong organizational, communication, and follow\-up skills.

$27\.50 \- $33\.50, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Apparel and Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

Orion hosts a wide range of events — from food pop\-ups and birthday parties to brand activations, private dinners, community gatherings, and industry events. This role will focus on **finding opportunities, pitching Orion, building relationships, and taking events from an initial idea through execution.**

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pitch potential event clients, brands, agencies, popups, creators, and organizations that could be a good fit for Orion
* Develop relationships across NYC’s food, hospitality, nightlife, creative, and Asian/Asian American communities
* Develop event proposals, menus, packages, and budgets with the Orion team
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, chefs, DJs, and other event partners
* Manage event logistics leading up to and during events
* Develop creative event concepts, partnerships, and programming that feel authentic to Orion

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is **outgoing, organized, entrepreneurial, and good at getting people excited about an idea.** Strong relationship\-building and sales instincts are important, as is the ability to independently identify opportunities and follow through.

Relevant backgrounds could include events, hospitality, food \& beverage, PR, brand partnerships, nightlife, production, or community building.

Because Orion is a **Korean\-American bar with deep ties to the Asian and Asian American community**, an existing network in those communities is a major plus. * NYC food, nightlife, or creative communities
* Strong communication and organizational skills

jobs.description:
**About Us**

MIH Systems Group is a growing company in the HVAC services field, and we work to make buildings work better. We specialize in optimizing complex HVAC systems in buildings. Our diverse team delivers value to our clients from the design stages of new construction through the operation of existing buildings. Our HVAC service team provides start\-up services for complex HVAC equipment from a wide range of manufacturers, as well as ongoing preventive maintenance, break/fix repair, and equipment retrofit services. Our Ambient team includes experienced professionals who focus on cost\-effective solutions for our clients.

  

  

**Job Description**  



**MIH Systems Group** is hiring an Administrator to support back\-office and executive operations across our New York business lines. This is a broad, hands\-on role combining HR/payroll administration, customer and billing support, travel logistics, and direct executive assistant support to the Vice President and Operations Director. It's well\-suited to someone who is detail\-obsessed, comfortable handling sensitive financial and personnel information, and energized by supporting multiple business lines at once rather than a single narrow function.


This role is a coordination/conduit function, not a decision\-owning one: the Administrator submits payroll, requests COIs, and routes customer paperwork, rather than administering payroll or the insurance program itself. That keeps the required seniority consistent across the role's responsibilities — this should be priced and titled as a coordinator\-level position, not an HR/benefits\-specialist role.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Submit payroll data on behalf of staff each cycle (manual process until automated)
* Serve as the point of contact between the team and payroll provider, ensuring timely and accurate submission
* Request certificates of insurance (COIs) from the broker for projects, vendors, and contracts as needed
* Track COI requests through to completion and maintain records for project files
* Collect client information (W\-9\), and set up them up in our business systems
* Support billing and invoicing workflows; assist with accounts receivable follow\-up as needed
* Book employee travel per existing SOP (refundable fares, corporate travel accounts)
* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for field engineers and leadership travel
* Provide direct administrative support to the Vice President and Operations Director, including calendar management, correspondence, and task follow\-up
* Assist with document preparation and light project coordination as needed
* Serve as a central administrative point of contact across business units
* Handle administrative projects as priorities shift across business lines

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of administrative or coordinator experience; exposure to payroll submission, insurance/COI requests, or customer onboarding processes a plus (not required to have owned these functions)
* Comfortable handling confidential financial and personnel data with discretion
* Strong follow\-through — this role is a conduit between the team and outside parties (payroll provider, insurance broker, customers), so nothing can fall through the cracks
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units
* Knowledge of HVAC/Construction background is preferred
* Experience with Dynamic365, CRM systems, or similar business platforms a plus
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work on\-site in New York, NY

**Estimated Salary:** $73,000 \- $88,000 annually with flexibility based on experience and skills.

  

  

Ambient Enterprises provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant supports the pastoral staff and daily operations of Church of the Advent Hope by executing defined recurring tasks and completing ad\-hoc assignments delegated by the Lead Pastor and the Pastor for Community Life. This role is an executor — not a strategist, operations director, or department head. The person in this role keeps the engine of the church running by handling inbound communications, coordinating the calendar with the Communications \& Marketing Director, and providing reliable, detail\-oriented support to the staff team.

Core Responsibility Areas

The Executive Assistant has three core responsibility areas. Everything this role does should be traceable back to one of these three buckets.

1\. Communications Triage (inbound)

* Monitor the general church inbox (info@adventhope.org and equivalent aliases) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine inquiries using approved templates; route pastoral, financial, or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate pastor or staff member within one business day.
* Monitor the church voicemail line daily during scheduled work hours. Return routine calls within one business day; forward pastoral\-care calls to the appropriate pastor by end of day.
* Monitor Intercom (website chat) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine questions; route complex questions to the right staff member.
* Receive and sort physical mail. Log checks and deposit\-ready items for the Bookkeeper; scan and forward time\-sensitive mail to the appropriate staff member.
* Maintain a running log of communications volume (counts by channel, types of inquiries) and report monthly to the Lead Pastor.

2\. Calendar and Schedule Coordination (with Communications \& Marketing Director)

* Maintain the master church calendar (Google Workspace) as the single source of truth for services, events, staff meetings, rentals, and pastoral availability.
* Work weekly with the Communications \& Marketing Director to confirm which events are being marketed, on what schedule, and through which channels (website, email, social). The Executive Assistant owns accuracy of the calendar; the Communications \& Marketing Director owns promotion of it.
* Open and confirm rental bookings on the calendar; coordinate with the Property Manager on room setup needs.
* Schedule and send calendar invites for pastoral staff meetings, board meetings, elders' meetings, and other recurring gatherings.
* Compile information packets for quarterly board meetings — agenda materials, prior minutes, supporting documents — and circulate in advance of the meeting.
* Handle RSVPs, sign\-ups, and registrations for events not handled by Eventbrite self\-service — e.g., baptism and baby dedication preparation, pastoral appointments, Conversations \& Cuisine seating.

3\. Staff Support and Task Execution

* Execute specific tasks assigned by the Lead Pastor or Pastor for Community Life through the shared task system (Todoist). Acknowledge receipt within 1 business day; confirm completion with a brief status update.
* Prepare Sabbath morning support materials: update the lobby announcement board, ensure interest cards and tithe cards are stocked, and stage any printed handouts provided by the Communications \& Marketing Director.
* Attend the weekly staff meeting and the weekly admin meeting (currently Tuesdays and Wednesdays via Zoom). Take notes and circulate action items within 1 business day.
* Compile materials for quarterly board meetings (does not attend the meeting itself); circulate minutes drafted by the Clerk.
* Maintain a simple, well\-organized filing system (Google Drive) for staff documents, vendor records, and church records.
* Order office supplies and Sabbath\-morning consumables (printer supplies, kitchen paper goods) against a pre\-approved budget set by the Lead Pastor.
* Maintain routine vendor relationships for administrative, office\-supply, and software\-subscription vendors — confirm invoices, process renewals, escalate issues. Building vendors, contractors, insurance, and renter relationships remain with the Property Manager.
* Provide administrative support for baptism, baby dedication, wedding, and funeral logistics as directed by a pastor.

Weekly Schedule

The Executive Assistant works a set weekly schedule, Tuesday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (20 hours per week):

* Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Staff meeting attendance; triage weekend email/voicemail backlog; circulate staff meeting action items.
* Wednesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Admin meeting attendance; calendar review with the Communications \& Marketing Director; weekly task triage.
* Thursday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Process mail; review routine vendor invoices and renewals; respond to ad\-hoc task list; weekly staff coordination.
* Friday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Sabbath preparation handoff to the Sabbath Coordinator and Support Team Lead; confirm next\-week calendar.

Schedule flexes during Advent, Holy Week, and the start of the church year. Additional hours during these peaks may be approved in advance by the Lead Pastor.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in email and phone contexts.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).
* Comfort learning and using digital tools (current stack includes Salesforce, Zoom, Squarespace, Todoist, Constant Contact, Mowgli, Intercom, Ramp, Proclaim; the Executive Assistant is not expected to administer all of these but will interact with several).
* Ability to use Anthropic Claude as a working tool — Claude will be part of the daily rhythm of this job for drafting, summarizing, triaging, and task execution. Willingness to learn responsible AI use within the church's guidelines is essential.
* Proficient at problem\-solving and getting things done — bias toward action, ability to close out tasks without repeated handholding

jobs.title: Vendor Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C\-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

  

End users enjoy a seamless, zero\-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all\-in\-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

  

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

  

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and \[solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry\-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

 **About the Role**


Order.co is looking for a Vendor Operations Associate to help ensure orders are fulfilled successfully/reconciled accurately, vendors are operating within our processes, and operational issues are resolved quickly and effectively.

  

This is an entry\-level role ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, investigating issues, and working with people. You'll spend your day monitoring orders, identifying roadblocks, collaborating with vendors and teammates, and ensuring customers receive a seamless experience.

  

The role sits within our Vendor Operations organization and works closely with Accounts Payable, Fulfillment Operations, Customer Success, and our offshore operations team.

  

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is not required.

 **What You'll Do**

**Keep Orders Moving**

* Proactively investigate outstanding orders to ensure they are progressing toward fulfillment
* Identify and resolve operational issues that could delay order completion
* Monitor workflows and follow up on orders requiring additional attention
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customers receive a smooth fulfillment experience

**Work Directly with Vendors**

* Communicate with vendors to resolve order issues, payment issues, and fulfillment questions
* Help vendors understand and comply with Order.co purchasing and fulfillment processes
* Identify recurring vendor behaviors that create operational challenges and work toward long\-term solutions
* Build productive relationships with vendor contacts while representing Order.co professionally

**Support Payment \& Operational Resolution**

* Investigate payment failures and help coordinate resolution efforts
* Assist with invoice and payment\-related workflows when needed
* Escalate issues appropriately and ensure follow\-through until resolution
* Help identify root causes behind recurring operational and payment issues

**Drive Continuous Improvement**

* Look for patterns and recurring issues across vendors, orders, and workflows
* Suggest improvements that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
* Collaborate with offshore team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Contribute to process documentation and operational best practices

 **What We're Looking For**

* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to stay organized while managing multiple priorities
* Comfortable solving problems independently and asking questions when needed
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Experience with spreadsheets, email, and business software is helpful but not required

 **Why This Role Matters**


Every day, thousands of orders flow through the Order.co platform. While many are automated, some require investigation, coordination, and problem solving to ensure successful completion.

  

This role serves as a critical bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams, helping ensure orders are fulfilled, vendors remain compliant with our processes, and operational issues are resolved before they impact the customer experience.

  

It's an opportunity to develop valuable skills in operations, vendor management, procurement, accounts payable, and process improvement while making an immediate impact on the business.

**What You'll Receive**
-----------------------

* A competitive compensation package including stock options
* Employer\-sponsored 401(k) with employer match
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents
* The anticipated hourly rate for this role is $25\-$27/hour. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Brooklyn, NY - 2027
jobs.description:
**Launch Your Sales Career at Topline Pro**
===========================================


We don't think a sales job should just teach you how to hit a number. It should teach you how to become great at sales. That's what this role is built to do.


As a BDR at Topline Pro, you'll join a team designed around learning, coaching, competition, and growth. You'll learn how to prospect, run discovery, demo our product, manage a pipeline, negotiate, and close business. More importantly, you'll learn how to take feedback, diagnose where you're getting stuck, and continuously get better at your craft.


You don't need years of sales experience to be successful here. We're much more interested in how you learn, how hard you're willing to work at something, how you respond when things don't go your way, and how much ownership you take over your own development.


In return, we're going to invest heavily in you.


You'll get regular coaching, role plays, call reviews, structured training, and a manager whose job isn't just to inspect your number, but to help you become a better seller. As you prove you're ready for more, you'll have opportunities to take on more responsibility and continue growing your career at Topline Pro.

**Growth here isn't about waiting your turn. It's about showing you're ready.**

**What the job actually looks like**
====================================


This is a high\-energy, high\-expectation sales environment. You'll be in our Williamsburg office five days a week, surrounded by people who want to get better and want the people around them to get better too. Our office is dog\-friendly and in the historic Domino Sugar Refinery at Domino Park.


You'll:

* Prospect home service business owners through high\-volume calling, email, and other outreach.
* Learn how to run great discovery conversations and understand what actually matters to a small business owner.
* Demo Topline Pro and connect our product to the problems you're hearing.
* Manage your own pipeline and learn how to move opportunities from first conversation through close.
* Participate regularly in coaching, role plays, call reviews, and team training.
* Get direct feedback and be expected to put it into practice quickly.
* Learn from your teammates, share what's working, and contribute to making the entire team better.
* Use our CRM and sales tools consistently to manage follow\-ups, prioritize opportunities, and stay organized.
* Learn how to use technology and AI to work smarter and become a more effective seller.
* Own your results. We'll give you coaching, tools, support, and opportunity, but what you do with them is up to you.

**Who tends to thrive here**
============================


We're less concerned with whether you've sold SaaS before and more interested in the person you're becoming. You'll probably love this environment if:

* **You want to get really good at something.** You're not just looking for your next job. You want to build skills and a career.
* **You're coachable.** You don't just listen to feedback. You try it, practice it, and come back better.
* **You're competitive with yourself.** You care about winning, but you're especially motivated by seeing yourself improve.
* **You're resilient.** Sales involves rejection. A bad call, bad day, or bad week doesn't change how you show up tomorrow.
* **You're curious.** You ask questions, want to understand why something works, and aren't satisfied memorizing a script.
* **You work hard.** There's no shortcut around the reps required to become great at sales.
* **You take ownership.** When something isn't working, your first instinct is to figure out what you can do differently.
* **You're a great teammate.** We compete, but not at each other's expense. We share what's working, help each other improve, and celebrate when someone else wins.
* **You're comfortable with change.** We're a fast\-growing company and we're constantly learning. Processes, messaging, and priorities will evolve as we get better.
* **You communicate well.** You can build trust with small business owners and communicate in a way that's clear, professional, and human.


Previous sales experience is helpful, but it isn't required. We're looking for people with the raw ingredients to become great sellers and the willingness to put in the work to get there.

**Where this can take you**
===========================


We want ambitious people.


This role is meant to build the foundation for a career in sales, and we want Topline Pro to be a place where you can keep building that career.


As you demonstrate mastery of the role, you'll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility, work more complex opportunities, and continue progressing as a seller.


We don't believe career growth should happen simply because you've been here long enough. **Opportunity is earned by showing you're ready for it.**


If you're looking for a comfortable job where you can blend into the middle of the pack, this probably won't be the right environment.


If you're looking for a place that will challenge you, coach you, invest in you, and give you the opportunity to grow faster than you thought possible, we'd love to meet you.

**Hiring Process**
==================


Our interview process is designed to get to know you beyond your resume and give you a chance to get to know us too. We'll be looking for the same qualities throughout the process that we value once you're here: curiosity, coachability, resilience, ownership, communication, and a genuine desire to grow.

* Recruiter Screen
* Sales Manager Screen
* Roleplay
* Leadership Screen

**What we offer**
=================

* $55k base salary with uncapped commissions ($100k\+ OTE) \+ equity package
* Full Medical, Dental, and Vision Health Coverage
* Computer and workspace enhancements
* 401(k) plan (non\-matching)
* Unlimited vacation, 9 company holidays, including election day, and 1 personal volunteer day a year
* Company\-paid Wellhu

Christian Dior was the designer of dreams. In founding his House in 1947, marked by the revolution of the New Look, he metamorphosed his reveries into wonderful creations. ***CHRISTIAN DIOR***
**MAISON**
-------------------------------

*“Whatever you do – whether for work or pleasure – do it with passion! Live with passion,”* wrote Christian Dior.
  

Well before he embarked on his destiny as a couturier, Christian Dior was fascinated with art. The young Normandy native and several friends opened an art gallery when he was just 23\. In 1938 he learned the métier of pattern cutter with Robert Piguet and three years later began working as a designer for Lucien Lelong. Right from the founding of his Maison in 1946, he transformed his dreams into irresistible creations, seeking to break with the somber war years by elevating pure joy. His visionary spirit celebrated and enchanted women the world over. In only ten years, Monsieur Dior revolutionized the conventions of elegance and femininity, designing collections infused with dreams.

Our services — JSTOR, Portico, and Ithaka S\+R — enable people everywhere to learn, to grow, and to overcome barriers to education. In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive.

**The Role**
------------



ITHAKA is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Digital Marketing Associate to provide part\-time fixed\-term (temporary) coverage and operational continuity for our digital marketing function. The associate will support ITHAKA's web and digital operations through website maintenance and quality assurance, reporting production, dashboard maintenance, campaign tracking support, paid advertising coordination, and project documentation.



Reporting to the Sr. Director, Channel Marketing, the associate will receive prioritized assignments from the project manager and work with subject matter experts across web, technology, data analytics, design, content marketing, and paid media for review and approvals. This fixed\-term (temporary) role does not own digital strategy, budget allocation, agency or consultant management, or final publishing and measurement decisions; those responsibilities remain with designated ITHAKA leaders and reviewers. Responsibilities will vary based on active campaigns, website needs, and reporting deadlines; the associate is not expected to perform every workstream listed below every week.



This fixed\-term (temporary) assignment is anticipated to begin in September 2026 and continue through April/May 2027\.



ITHAKA has physical offices in New York City and Ann Arbor, Michigan, with employees distributed across the continental United States. At this time, we're not considering candidates who reside outside of the continental U.S.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Conduct website quality assurance using established checklists, including reviewing links, forms, confirmation states, thank you pages, metadata, calls to action, formatting, mobile behavior, basic accessibility requirements, and published updates; document results and follow\-up issues.
* Make pre\-approved, low\-risk CMS updates after training, including updating existing content modules, replacing links or assets, verifying redirects, checking previews, verifying redirects, and preparing or publishing changes according to the established approval process.
* Support implementation and validation of pre\-approved, well\-scoped marketing site backlog items; escalate requests involving strategy, information architecture, custom development, or significant content changes.
* Support SEO and site health monitoring by running Semrush reports, logging broken links or media, documenting metadata and crawl/indexation issues, maintaining the site health backlog, and escalating high\-priority technical or content issues.
* Produce recurring reports by pulling data from approved sources, updating source sheets, assembling charts and screenshots, documenting caveats, and populating reporting deck templates.
* Maintain and quality\-check existing dashboards and reporting tools, including filters, date ranges, labels, calculations, and source links; assist with small, clearly scoped dashboard builds using established requirements or templates.
* Create and quality\-check UTM links and campaign naming; verify landing page links, forms, thank you page behavior, and attribution paths; document discrepancies for the appropriate analytics or tracking owner.
* Support paid advertising operations by maintaining campaign trackers and Asana tasks, collecting weekly status information, quality\-checking URLs and UTMs, organizing briefs and creative links, and documenting launch readiness and campaign status.
* Depending on priorities and available capacity, the Associate may also support approved web testing or other clearly scoped digital projects through QA, status tracking, observation logs, and documentation.
* Maintain project hygiene across active web, reporting, paid, tracking, and dashboard workstreams by keeping owners, statuses, links, standard operating procedures, handoff notes, and return notes current.
* Follow established access, data handling, publishing, and approval processes, and escalate questions, discrepancies, or higher\-risk changes to the designated reviewer or decision\-maker.

**Experience and Skills**
-------------------------


* One or more years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, web production, analytics support, or a related role; relevant internship or project experience may be considered.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to quality\-check digital content, links, forms, naming conventions, dates, filters, and source data.
* Experience working in content management systems and familiarity with website publishing workflows, page previews, redirects, metadata, and basic accessibility practices.
* Experience with WordPress or a comparable CMS is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of campaign tracking concepts, including UTM parameters, naming conventions, landing pages, forms, and attribution paths.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets and reporting data; familiarity with GA4, Salesforce, Looker, Tableau, Semrush, and paid advertising platforms, or comparable tools, is preferred.
* Experience using Asana or similar project management platform and maintaining clear task statuses, documentation, links, and handoff notes.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage recurring tasks and increased workloads during reporting and launch periods.

At our core, we believe that everyone deserves access to the solutions they need to achieve financial freedom. * *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

* You’re the kind of person who thrives on hitting targets \& metrics.

jobs.description:
The Company


Founded in 2012, What If Media Group is an award\-winning performance marketing company that enables the world’s leading brands to acquire valuable new customers at scale. By leveraging data\-driven engagement and re\-engagement strategies across multiple marketing channels, and utilizing insights based on millions of consumer ad interactions each day, WIMG delivers cost\-effective and profitable performance marketing solutions that extend lifetime value and maximize ROI. Headquartered in Fort Lee, New Jersey, with a satellite office in New York City, WIMG is a multi\-year honoree of both the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest growing private companies in America and Crain’s Fast 50, which recognizes the New York area’s most rapidly expanding companies based on revenue.  

The Role


We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to work in a hybrid role based out of either our Fort Lee, NJ \& New York City offices, or out of our Boca Raton office. As an Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR), you have an opportunity to be a key strategic contributor to the What If Media Group Sales Team. You will help pinpoint qualified leads for various Sales Team members and set meetings for others to attend to close deals.

* Work either from our Fort Lee, NJ/New York City offices or our Boca Raton office 2\-3 days per week.

  

Education \& Experience

* BS/BA or Associate’s degree preferred, but not mandatory

  

Requirements

* Sharp, self\-starter, go\-getter, motivated by reaching numbers/goals.
* Team player, and excellent listener \- assertive and persuasive. Show us your grit!
* Exhibit strong communication skills \- both written and verbal.
* Diligent, conscientious, pays close attention to detail.

jobs.title: Talent Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**


adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.  

  

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.  

  

Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

##### **The Role**


As a Talent Operations Coordinator at adMarketplace, you'll help ensure our hiring process runs smoothly from opening a role through offer acceptance. You'll partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver an exceptional candidate experience while supporting recruiting operations, reporting, and process improvements.


In addition to supporting day\-to\-day recruiting, you'll help manage our Challenger and Internship Programs, contributing to the growth of our early\-career talent pipeline.

##### **What You'll Do**

**Recruiting Coordination \& Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate video and onsite interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process.
* Manage interview logistics, including scheduling, travel, onsite support, and candidate communications.
* Build interview plans, scorecards, coordinate interview panels, and ensure timely interview feedback.
* Help coordinate offer administration, background checks, reference checks and new hire Jira tickets.

**Recruiting Operations**

* Maintain job postings, requisitions, and candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System.
* Prepare recruiting reports, executive updates, dashboards and hiring metrics.
* Support recruiting vendors, recruiting technologies, and system administration.
* Maintain recruiting documentation, templates, and operating procedures.
* Handle new hire onboarding and orientation.
* Work with Learning and Development on new hire onboarding plans.

**Programs \& Process Improvement**

* Co\-lead the Challenger (new grad) Program and Internship Program, including recruitment, onboarding, program coordination, and participant experience.
* Track recruiting metrics and identify opportunities to improve hiring efficiency and candidate experience.
* Support cross\-functional Talent Acquisition projects and process improvements.
* Partner with People Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and business leaders to support recruiting initiatives.
* Take on special projects as needed across Talent Acquisition and People Ops.

##### **What You'll Bring**

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, HR, project coordination, or a related field.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* High agency with the ability to anticipate hiring needs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A positive, engaging presence with the ability to represent adMarketplace to candidates in an enthusiastic, authentic, and professional manner.
* Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System (Teamtailor, Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or similar) is preferred.
* Comfortable using Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, AI and reporting tools to organize and analyze information.
* A proactive mindset with an interest in improving processes and creating operational excellence.


Compensation: $70,000 \- $85,000 \+ Bonus \& Equity

##### **Join Us**


adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s\- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!


We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company\-wide lunch and learns, and well\-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.


At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either.


We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.


No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.


This range represents the low and high end of the base salary someone in this role may earn as an employee of adMarketplace in the New York office. Salaries will vary based on various factors including but not limited to professional and academic experience; training; associated responsibilities; and other business and organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of our total compensation package for employees. Salary decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each hire.

jobs.title: CFO Personal Assistant / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
CFO Personal Assistant / Executive Assistant

Company: Epay World  
Location: 100 East Broadway, New York, NY 10002  
Job Type: Full\-Time  
Department: Executive / Finance  
Reports To: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Job Summary

Epay World is seeking a highly organized, responsible, and detail\-oriented CFO Personal Assistant / Executive Assistant to provide direct administrative and operational support to the Chief Financial Officer.

This position is ideal for someone who is organized, professional, comfortable handling multiple priorities, and able to work with confidential business and financial information.

The Personal Assistant will help the CFO manage schedules, meetings, documents, communications, follow\-ups, financial administrative tasks, and coordination with internal departments and outside business partners.

Key Responsibilities  
Manage the CFO’s daily calendar, appointments, meetings, and reminders.  
Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings.  
Prepare meeting agendas, documents, reports, and follow\-up notes.  
Track assignments, deadlines, and action items for the CFO.  
Follow up with employees and department leaders regarding outstanding tasks.  
Assist with organizing financial reports, invoices, contracts, and business documents.  
Help maintain organized electronic files and company records.  
Assist with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable administrative tasks when needed.  
Prepare Excel spreadsheets, summaries, and basic reports.  
Draft and organize emails, letters, announcements, and business communications.  
Communicate professionally with banks, accountants, vendors, investors, lenders, business partners, and customers.  
Assist the CFO with investment, financing, budgeting, and business\-development documentation.  
Coordinate document collection from Accounting, HR, Sales, Operations, and other departments.  
Maintain confidentiality regarding company financial and executive information.  
Assist with special projects assigned by the CFO.  
Perform general executive and administrative support duties as needed.  
Qualifications  
Strong organizational and time\-management skills.  
Excellent attention to detail.  
Good written and verbal communication skills.  
Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Google Workspace.  
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.  
Professional attitude and strong sense of responsibility.  
Ability to follow instructions and complete assignments on time.  
Comfortable working with confidential financial and company information.  
Basic accounting or bookkeeping knowledge is a plus.  
Previous administrative assistant, executive assistant, accounting assistant, or office experience is preferred.  
Preferred Skills

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

Microsoft Excel  
QuickBooks  
Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable  
Bookkeeping  
Financial reporting  
Google Drive / Google Workspace  
Smartsheet  
CRM systems  
Document management  
Investor or lender documentation  
Executive calendar management  
What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Organized  
Reliable  
Detail\-oriented  
Professional  
Responsive  
Able to follow up consistently  
Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment  
Willing to learn different areas of the business

An established trauma\-informed behavioral health agency serving individuals and families through clinical and community\-based programs is seeking a dependable, highly organized Clinical Intake \& Administrative Coordinator. The organization values compassionate service, accuracy, professionalism, accountability, and consistent follow\-through. The employer's identity will be shared with selected candidates as they advance in the interview process.

The Administrative Coordinator supports the agency's daily administrative, intake, scheduling, documentation, and front\-office operations. This person is often the first point of contact for clients, referral partners, applicants, and visitors and must communicate with warmth, professionalism, and discretion.

Success in this role requires someone who can independently manage recurring responsibilities, maintain accurate records, close the loop on assigned tasks, recognize when follow\-up is needed, and promptly communicate barriers rather than allowing work to remain incomplete.

· Serve as a professional first point of contact by phone, email, and in person.

· Respond to inquiries, gather required information, route requests appropriately, and document each interaction accurately.

· Support client intake and onboarding processes, including forms, reminders, follow\-up, and status tracking.

· Maintain a welcoming, organized, and confidential front\-office environment.

Scheduling \& Coordination

· Coordinate counseling appointments, assessments, meetings, interviews, rooms, and agency resources.

· Send timely confirmations and reminders and address scheduling changes promptly.

· Prepare materials and coordinate logistics for scheduled assessment and service activities.

Documentation, Reporting \& Compliance

· Maintain accurate electronic and physical records using electronic health record systems and Microsoft 365\.

· Generate and review routine reports, identify missing or overdue items, and follow up with the appropriate person.

· Prepare professional letters, memos, agendas, templates, and other administrative documents.

· Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA, agency, contractual, and applicable documentation requirements.

Operational \& Leadership Support

· Track onboarding documents, credentials, training records, and recurring administrative deadlines.

· Support supply ordering, mail, scanning, filing, printing, and other office systems.

· Assist leadership with project coordination, meeting preparation, action\-item tracking, and follow\-up.

· Maintain task lists and provide clear status updates until assignments are fully completed.

· Perform other reasonable duties consistent with the position and agency needs.

· At least two years of administrative assistant, office coordination, intake, or comparable experience.
