jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT REPAY
  

REPAY (“Realtime Electronic Payments” / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast\-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.


ABOUT THE ROLE


REPAY is seeking an Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) to serve as a trusted technical advisor to our strategic enterprise clients. The eTAM will own the ongoing technical relationship with an assigned portfolio of complex clients, developing a deep understanding of their technical environments, integrations, payment workflows, and business priorities.


This highly visible, client\-facing role partners closely with clients and internal teams to ensure the ongoing performance and success of REPAY solutions. The eTAM will provide technical guidance, manage complex technical issues and escalations, **and help clients optimize and expand their use of REPAY's technology.**

The eTAM will work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, and Sales to advocate for client needs and drive successful outcomes.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor and key point of contact for assigned enterprise clients, developing a strong understanding of their business needs, technical environments, and use of REPAY solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions.
* Provide technical guidance and consultation to clients throughout the lifecycle of the relationship, helping them navigate REPAY's products, capabilities, and integrations.
* Partner with clients and internal teams to understand technical needs, identify solutions, and support successful outcomes.
* Proactively identify potential technical risks, challenges, and opportunities within assigned client relationships and help drive appropriate action.
* Coordinate and support the resolution of complex technical issues and client escalations, engaging the appropriate internal resources as needed.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, Sales, and other teams to address client needs and priorities.
* Serve as an advocate for enterprise clients internally, helping communicate client feedback, business needs, technical requirements, and emerging priorities.
* Support the adoption and ongoing success of REPAY products and solutions within assigned enterprise accounts.
* Provide technical insight and support for client discussions, strategic initiatives, new opportunities, and evolving business needs.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen REPAY's enterprise client experience, technical account management practices, and internal processes.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge of REPAY's products, technology, integrations, and industry trends to effectively advise and support clients.
* Perform other responsibilities and support strategic initiatives as needed based on evolving client and business needs.
* Rotating assignment for technical off\-hours on\-call support of our strategic enterprise accounts.

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE NEEDED**

* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Engineering, or a similar client\-facing technical role.
* Experience supporting enterprise or complex clients within a SaaS, fintech, payments, or technology environment.
* Strong understanding of API\-based integrations, including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, and system\-to\-system integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex technical issues and coordinate resolution across multiple technical teams.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, integrations, and workflows.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with both technical stakeholders and senior business leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients, initiatives, escalations, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive, ownership\-oriented approach.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and Account Management organizations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience within payments, fintech, financial services technology, or another highly integrated transaction\-processing environment.
* Knowledge of payment processing concepts, including card and ACH transaction flows, payment gateways, settlement, reconciliation, tokenization, and payment security.
* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools such as Postman.
* Familiarity with SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, or similar technical troubleshooting methods.
* Experience supporting high\-volume, mission\-critical platforms or complex enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS and other security or compliance requirements applicable to payment proce

jobs.description:
* 2026
* Alpharetta, Georgia
* Client Service
* full\-time
* Works from an office location
* 16
* USD $106,000\.00/Yr.
* USD $173,000\.00/Yr.


  
**Job Description**
-------------------


Established nearly two centuries ago, FM is a leading mutual insurance company whose capital, scientific research capability and engineering expertise are solely dedicated to property risk management and the resilience of its policyholder\-owners. These owners, who share the belief that the majority of property loss is preventable, represent many of the world’s largest organizations, including one of every four Fortune 500 companies. They work with FM to better understand the hazards that can impact their business continuity to make cost\-effective risk management decisions, combining property loss prevention with insurance protection.


FM's Atlanta, Georgia Operation has an opening for a dynamic Account Manager in our Client Service Department. This position will perform insurance servicing and underwriting activities on existing accounts and new business. This position's primary function is to serve as the account team leader or manager of the account. Serve as key/primary interface with clients/brokers on all aspects of the account including insurance products and services, engineering, and claims services.


**This position is for an AM I to AM II, depending on the level of the candidate’s skill and experience. Varying levels of experience and qualifications will be considered.**


* Maintain a profitable book of business by effective use of sales techniques, client relationships, risk assessments, application of sound underwriting principles and creative use of underwriting resources.
* Ensure premium growth by retaining existing clients through value added service, by selling additional product lines and by establishing equitable terms and conditions on new accounts introduced by sales executives. Ensure policies accurately reflect both the insured’s and FM's intent of coverage.
* Provide professional advice and consultation to all clients on insurance coverages and risk management matters making them aware of the benefits derived from various products and services offered by FM.
* In coordination with Account Engineers, establish risk improvement priorities and support efforts to acquire client compliance with loss prevention recommendations.
* Protect FM's assets through creative use of company underwriting programs and adherence to published guidelines which include: Line setting techniques, judicious purchase of reinsurance (where warranted), timely issuance of policies, catastrophe aggregate analysis, MFL analysis and cross liability checks.
* Collect outstanding premium balances in a timely manner to meet the Operation’s goals and objectives.
* Continue professional development including maintaining necessary licensing. Continue to update knowledge of underwriting guidelines, policy forms, loss prevention practices and insurance industry developments.
* Provide leadership to the overall FM account team, ensuring that the Client Service Process is implemented effectively and efficiently.
* Handle change by prioritizing routine activities, workloads, and projects and through delegating to support staff as necessary.
* Evaluate manuscript coverage/wording requests: analyze existing policy language; degree and type of exposure; pricing; and develop additional policy language if warranted.

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; CPCU or ARM desired!
* Minimum 5\+ years FM experience or 5\+ years industry experience (broker, insurance, reinsurance company) in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* FM loss prevention engineering background desired.
* Previous experience as an Underwriter for FM is desired.
* Power Generation Loss Prevention or Underwriting experience is desired.
* Demonstrated effectiveness at accessing and influencing the decision maker.
* Strong familiarity with FM's client service process preferred.
* Experience in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* Working knowledge of property insurance and forms, financial statements, general loss prevention engineering terms and concepts as well as business computer applications.
* Demonstrated above average ability in organization, problem solving, sales/negotiation, leadership and team building skills.
* Knowledge of internal systems and Microsoft Office products.

The final salary offer will vary based on geographic location, individual education, skills, and experience. The position is eligible to participate in FM’s comprehensive Total Rewards program that includes an incentive plan, generous health, and well\-being programs, a 401(k) and pension plan, career development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, flexible work, time off allowances, and much more!


FM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce.

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and be part of an innovative, mission\-driven team, apply now!

The Key Account Manager – Home Depot Pro and Field Sales will oversee all aspects of Quote Center, Pro Desk, Field Sales and Training for the THD account team. This role is accountable for building a strong relationship with Home Depot Field and PRO leadership to achieve annual sales objectives. The position is responsible for training and cultivating all outside Pro sales personnel and working with inside Pro sales personnel in closing new business opportunities with single\-family home builders, multi\-family developers/contractors, and remodeling companies. The Account Manager is responsible for ensuring all sales programs are known to Pro and Field personnel to drive revenue and market share.

* Provide monthly field communication with any relevant product and building code updates.

* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator
jobs.description:
About the Role

Melo Vision Media is looking for a Bilingual Content Creator / Social Media Assistant to join our growing team in the Atlanta area.

This is a paid, flexible position focused mainly on helping us create content for our local clients. You’ll be our on\-the\-ground support in Atlanta, while our remote team handles social media strategy, graphic design, editing, scheduling, and overall marketing.

Most of our clients are restaurants and hospitality\-based businesses, so we’re looking for someone who is creative, outgoing, comfortable working with clients, and understands how to capture content that feels natural and engaging on social media.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your main responsibility will be attending content shoots for different clients throughout the month. Depending on our schedule, this may be around 1–2 shoots per week, with the amount of work varying as we add new clients.

You’ll be responsible for:

* Filming short\-form content for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, etc.
* Taking photos and capturing additional behind\-the\-scenes content when needed.
* Coming to shoots prepared with content ideas and helping direct what we capture.
* Communicating directly with clients to coordinate shoot dates, times, and availability.
* Uploading and organizing all footage into our shared folders after each shoot so our remote team can edit and publish it.
* Occasionally attending meetings or introductions with new clients.
* Becoming a reliable local point of contact for Melo Vision Media and our Atlanta\-area clients.

What We’re Looking For

Bilingual Spanish \+ English is required. This is one of the most important requirements for the position since many of our clients are Spanish\-speaking and/or Latin American businesses.

Being familiar with South American/Latin American culture is a big plus, especially since several of our restaurant clients are South American. We want someone who understands the culture, food, humor, hospitality, and customer experience enough to create content that feels authentic.

You should also:

* Have your own reliable transportation and be comfortable driving to different client locations.
* Have an iPhone with a good\-quality camera for filming content.
* Have access to a computer to upload and organize large photo/video files.
* Be comfortable communicating directly with business owners and clients.
* Be outgoing, responsible, organized, and creative.
* Understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and current social media trends.
* Be comfortable working independently during shoots.

Locations

Our current shoots are primarily around:

Suwanee **Lawrenceville**  Monroe **Smyrna**  Atlanta

Because locations vary depending on the client, reliable transportation is essential.

Schedule \& Pay

This is a flexible, paid position rather than a traditional 9–5 role. The number of shoots may vary from week to week depending on our client schedule.

Compensation will be discussed based on availability, experience, and the number of shoots assigned.

There is also room for the position to grow as Melo Vision Media takes on more clients. Over time, we’d love for this person to become our right hand in Atlanta for content creation and local client relationships.

If you love social media, enjoy creating content, are comfortable working with people, and want hands\-on experience working with different brands and businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Pay: From $15\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30303

jobs.title: Community Outreach Partner - North Georgia
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**


The Community Outreach Partner supports the execution of localized, territory\-based community engagement and referral development for Flournoy Health Systems across Georgia. This role is responsible for building strong local relationships, developing referral sources, increasing community awareness, and contributing to a consistent, measurable referral pipeline across assigned regions.


The Community Outreach Partner serves as a key representative of Flournoy Health Systems within the communities it serves. This role focuses on territory\-specific execution through direct relationship\-building with local organizations, referral sources, healthcare partners, and community stakeholders. The Community Outreach Partner is accountable for prospecting, outreach activity, referral source development, partnership follow\-up, territory visibility, and accurate CRM documentation to support a scalable, high\-performing referral pipeline across all assigned territories.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute territory\-based community outreach plans aligned with organizational growth and referral goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with referral sources, community organizations, healthcare partners, and local stakeholders across assigned territories
* Identify, prospect, and develop new referral source opportunities to strengthen the local pipeline and expand territory reach
* Maintain regular in\-person outreach activity across the territory to ensure consistent visibility, relationship development, and local market presence
* Represent Flournoy Health Systems professionally in the community through meetings, events, networking opportunities, and partnership development efforts
* Support referral growth across all service lines, including Structured Family Caregiving, traditional caregiving, Pediatrics (skilled nursing and personal support), and Hospice care (and new services)
* Track all outreach activity, referral source engagement, follow\-up tasks, and partnership updates within the CRM in real time
* Operate fully within the CRM, maintaining accurate data, timely follow\-up, clear account ownership, and visibility into territory activity and pipeline development
* Follow established outreach workflows, processes, operating rhythms, and accountability standards to ensure consistency across territories
* Partner closely with leadership to communicate market feedback, local opportunities, relationship risks, and territory needs
* Monitor individual outreach performance, referral activity, and account development progress against defined goals
* Support territory planning and outreach initiatives tailored to local market needs and community dynamics
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness, organization, professionalism, and follow\-through in all relationship and referral development efforts
* Collaborate with peers across different regions and territories to support organizational growth and relationship transition when required
* Lead clinical recruiting efforts in designated areas, including actively sourcing and recruiting qualified LPNs and RNs, while supporting the growth and development of new service areas.
* Travel regularly throughout assigned territories across Georgia to support community presence and outreach execution

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in healthcare\-related sales, community outreach, relationship management, business development, field marketing, or related fields
* Fluency maintaining sales data in CRM. Experience with Hubspot is a plus.
* Healthcare experience required; home care, home health, hospice, or Medicaid\-funded programs strongly preferred
* Proven ability to build relationships, develop local partnerships, and support referral growth within assigned markets
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Professional, polished presence with the ability to engage a wide range of community and healthcare stakeholders
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable managing outreach activity across a defined territory
* Results\-driven with strong follow\-up, accountability, and work ethics
* Working knowledge of Medicaid and Medicare programs is a plus
* Valid driver’s license, reliable vehicle and ability to travel regularly across Georgia
* **Must live in the North Georgia area**

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - East Coast
jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the East Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the East Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the East Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the East Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Living and located on the Central to East Coast, USA
* Hospitality experience required
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles
* AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands\-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result


**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**



Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.



This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.



If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process \- your recruiter will be able to help.


#### **What's in it for you?**



Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.


#### **Global benefits**



No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:


* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work\-from\-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**



You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.


#### **Life at Mews**



We're an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serv

jobs.title: Executive Assistant I
jobs.description:
Municipal Court of Atlanta


Executive Assistant I


Posting Expires: September 11, 2026


Salary: $70, 000/annually  



**General Description and Classification Standards:**

This class coordinates complex administrative services within an assigned department. Performs and oversees technical and office administrative duties in support of the assigned Department Head. Serves as a liaison between an assigned department and other administrative and support departments, oversees support operations of large complex and or diverse city departments. May supervise clerical and other support staff; may be in charge of a specific area of assignment as directed by the Department Head. This is an experienced skilled position that routinely works with the most challenging assignments; serves as a specialized subject matter expert in one or more specific areas; and guides the work of others.

Work methods and assignment results are typically reviewed by a more experienced professional or a manager prior to final action.

* Performs a wide variety of executive secretarial and administrative duties as required by daily operations within the assigned department.
* Coordinates office activities and schedules; develops and recommends office policies, procedures and systems; ensures smooth office operations.
* Assists in preparing speeches and news releases.
* Researches and analyzes routine administrative projects for the Department Head.
* Receives and screens all communications to the Department Head including telephone calls and email messages; provides assistance using independent judgment to determine messages that require priority attention; prioritizes and facilitates communication.

* Selects from multiple procedures and methods to accomplish tasks; applies organizational policies.

* Knowledge and skills in the use of computers.
* Knowledge of management and administrative practices, policies, and procedures as necessary in the completion of daily responsibilities.
* Knowledge of all applicable laws, ordinances, policies, standards, and regulations pertaining to the specific duties and responsibilities of the job.

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional\-quality rental housing. Chicago Human Rhythm Project (CHRP) is the nation’s largest and only year\-round presenter of American tap dance and contemporary percussive arts. We are seeking a Facilities and Programs Operations Coordinator to manage day\-to\-day operations of the Mayfair Arts Center, our arts incubator in Calumet Heights, along with production coordination of our seasonal and core education and performance programs. A project of Chicago Human Rhythm Project, the Mayfair Arts Center (MAC) is a collaborative effort to foster community growth through rhythmic expression. We aim to offer diverse, high\-quality dance and movement classes to the general public while centralizing the education programs, rehearsal space and informal performances of several core groups, as well as supporting additional emerging companies and independent artists. jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us**


Family Entertainment Group (FEG), is a recognized industry leader in designing, developing, and operating world\-class family entertainment centers and amusement experiences. With a commitment to innovation and guest satisfaction, FEG partners with top brands and venues to create memorable experiences for families and guests of all ages. The Company provides turnkey outsourced facility management and arcade operations services for resorts, hotels, casinos, and amusement parks. Additionally, the Company owns and operates standalone family entertainment centers under the In The Game, Max Action, and Bonkers brands. The Company operates nearly 90 locations throughout the U.S.

**Position Summary**


The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the hands\-on, point\-to\-point movement of shipments and equipment across all Family Entertainment Group locations, including obtaining freight quotes directly from manufacturers and setting up and coordinating wrap\-and\-roll freight for asset transfers. This is an individual\-contributor role: the Coordinator executes logistics tasks directly , and reports to the Parts \& Service Manager. When logistics volume allows, which is the minority of the role, the Coordinator also supports the Parts \& Service department with picking, packing, and shipping parts, fielding service calls, and general department assistance.

**Key Responsibilities – Logistics (Primary)**

* Coordinate all point\-to\-point logistics for shipments, equipment, and assets moving between manufacturers, corporate, and field locations.
* Obtain and compare freight quotes directly from manufacturers for shipments to individual locations, selecting the best combination of cost and transit time.
* Set up and coordinate wrap\-and\-roll freight for game and equipment transfers between locations.
* Book and schedule freight shipments for asset transfers between locations.
* Track shipments in transit and proactively communicate ETAs, delays, and exceptions to the field and Parts \& Service Manager and affected locations.
* Prepare and review shipping documentation, including bills of lading, freight quotes, and tracking information, for accuracy.
* Negotiate rates and service terms with carriers and freight forwarders to control shipping costs.
* Maintain organized records of freight quotes, carrier contacts, and shipment history.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to reduce freight costs, transit times, and shipping errors.

**Key Responsibilities – Parts \& Service Support (Secondary)**

* Assist with picking, packing, and shipping parts orders to field locations.
* Assist with receiving, organizing, labeling, and storing parts inventory, maintaining proper par levels.
* Take and route incoming service calls from field technicians.
* Assist field technicians with parts identification, handling, and ordering processes.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory audits as needed.
* Assist with RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processing with manufacturers as needed.
* Provide general support to the Parts \& Service department as directed by the Parts \& Service Manager.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in logistics, freight coordination, shipping/receiving, or transportation coordination.
* Experience obtaining and comparing freight quotes; familiarity with LTL/FTL and wrap\-and\-roll freight preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines at once.
* Clear, proactive verbal and written communication with carriers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams.
* Comfortable using basic computer and database tools (Excel, inventory or ERP systems).
* Willingness and ability to take on secondary duties, including picking/packing parts, fielding service calls, and general department support.
* Must be physically capable of lifting 50\+ lbs and working in warehouse conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required; additional training in logistics or supply chain is a plus.

jobs.title: Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

Our Business Development Coordinator is responsible for generating new business opportunities by researching target accounts, identifying prospective clients and decision\-makers, engaging prospects, and qualifying opportunities. This role serves as the front line of the sales organization, with a focus on new business development, relationship building, and creating a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for Business Development Managers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Lead Generation and Prospecting**

* Research target accounts, industries, companies, and decision\-makers to identify new business opportunities.
* Develop and organize prospect lists using available research, CRM, LinkedIn, networking, and other business development resources.
* Tailor outreach based on prospect research, business needs, and potential opportunities.
* Generate through outreach.

**Lead Qualification**

* Gather and document information about prospect needs, timing, business priorities, and potential fit.
* Ensure all leads passed to BDMs meet qualification standards.

**Pipeline Development**

* Coordinate discovery calls and meetings for Business Development Managers and ensure relevant prospect information is communicated in advance.
* Assist with preparing presentations, proposals, research, and other materials that support new business opportunities.
* Support pipeline growth by maintaining a steady flow of qualified opportunities

**CRM \& Data Management**

* Maintain data integrity of prospect and account records.
* Accurately log all research and communication activities (calls, emails, meetings).
* Ensure accurate tracking of sales process flow.
* Leverage technology and automation to improve efficiency.

**Collaboration \& Alignment**

* Work closely with Business Development Managers, marketing, and operations to align prospecting efforts and support new business opportunities.
* Ensure prospect information, qualification details, and next steps are clearly communicated during hand\-offs to Business Development Managers.

Requirements:

* 1\-3\+ years of experience in business development, sales, sales support, customer\-facing, research, or a related role.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage with prospects.
* Proactive and self\-motivated with a results\-driven mindset.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite) and sales prospecting tools, such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**



HirexHire (pronounced hire by hire) is a Chicago\-based recruiting and talent consultancy that integrates with companies short\-term to provide long\-term talent solutions. We take a seat in our client’s everyday operations to understand their people's goals, gaps, and challenges. We then develop and implement the processes and technologies to execute a sustainable and scalable talent plan.



We partner with companies expecting or experiencing high growth that need to hire at scale or fill a critical role rapidly. Our clients are not looking for quick\-fix placements but are thoughtfully building a hiring strategy to scale their businesses.


**Location:** Remote within the Chicagoland area, with occasional in\-person team meetings and events  

**Compensation:** $45,000 \- $60,000 annually \+ bonus eligibility  

**Company Size:** 6 employees

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**



As a Recruiting Coordinator, your focus is on supporting all aspects of the full lifecycle recruiting process in collaboration with our Recruiting Consultants, clients, and candidates. You can expect to help write job descriptions and manage job postings, source and screen resumes, coordinate interviews, and create, send, and collect offers and onboarding documents for our customers.



This person will be one of two primary points of contact for our clients regarding candidates in process, interview scheduling, and overall pipeline activity and metrics. There will be many different people to meet and work with, so we look for candidates who are genuinely interested in our clients’ teams and cultures and attentive to the needs of others. Our team is small and growing, so you can expect to wear many hats and take ownership of broader organizational initiatives to improve our operations and services.

  


**ABOUT YOU**


* You thrive in a high\-paced environment and work well with other like\-minded people
* You are thoughtful, accountable, and jump at opportunities to work on various internal projects
* You’re motivated by building teams in an evolving organization and enjoy seeing the direct results of your work
* You’re able to manage competing priorities while staying organized and maintaining a positive candidate experience
* You’re interested in growing with a company and contributing to the continued development of its recruiting function

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**


* Support Recruiting Consultants and clients across all stages of the recruiting process, ensuring strong organization, communication, and follow\-through
* Assist with role intake, job description development, sourcing, candidate screening, interview coordination, offers, and onboarding support
* Develop and manage job postings across appropriate channels to attract qualified, targeted talent
* Source, screen, and assess candidates while building and maintaining strong, diverse talent pipelines
* Coordinate and facilitate phone, video, and in\-person interviews, ensuring an efficient and organized interview process
* Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates and hiring managers, providing transparency throughout the recruiting lifecycle
* Track recruiting activity and key performance metrics, delivering regular updates and insights to stakeholders

  

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum 2 years of recruiting experience in a recruiting coordinator, recruiting assistant, sourcing, or similar corporate or agency recruiting role
* Experience supporting recruitment for technical talent \- such as software engineers, developers, and IT professionals \- and the ability to understand technical concepts, tools, and roles
* Excellent customer service and confidence communicating with hiring managers, candidates, and cross\-functional partners
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, Workable, Ashby, and LinkedIn Recruiter
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset with a strong bias toward action
* Experience supporting a software, technology, start\-up, or venture capital or private equity\-backed organization is a plus

  

### **BENEFITS**


* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible Remote Work Environment
* Unlimited PTO
* Your Choice of New Technology (Mac or Windows)
* Quarterly Team Outings

* Maintain close relationship with outside sales.
* Support Outside sales and accounting with pricing or invoice issues.
* Answer and transfer company calls to the appropriate department as needed.

* Detail oriented and ability to manage multiple projects/accounts.

This job operates in a production office environment, including offices, warehouse, and storerooms. Maybe exposed to elements such as noise, dust, fumes and odors.

None

* Competitive Wages

$94,890\.40 \- $130,000\.00
This position is bonus and/or commission eligible.


CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

**The Role**
============


The Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support is a senior technical, customer\-facing individual contributor responsible for supporting the reliability and operational health of CCC’s enterprise customers. The role focuses primarily on strategic automotive accounts with the most complex technical environments and support needs, while also providing technical expertise and escalation support across the broader enterprise customer base.  

  

Serving as a senior technical escalation point and trusted advisor, this role combines hands\-on troubleshooting and advanced API support with cross\-functional coordination. The role resolves issues directly when possible, engages the appropriate Engineering, Product, Support, or other technical teams when additional expertise is required, and maintains clear ownership through resolution.  

  

The Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support develops a deep understanding of customer environments, proactively identifies operational risks, and recommends improvements that strengthen reliability, scalability, security, and customer outcomes. This position leads incident communications, service reviews, and post\-incident discussions through technical expertise, consultation, and influence rather than direct people management.**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

**Customer Escalation, Technical Ownership \& Incident Leadership**

* Serve as a senior technical escalation point for CCC’s enterprise customers, with primary day\-to\-day focus on strategic automotive accounts that have the most complex technical environments and support needs.
* Provide hands\-on troubleshooting and advanced API support for complex customer issues, resolving problems directly when possible and engaging the appropriate technical experts when additional support is required.

jobs.title: DTC Account Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About Blue Wheel**

Blue Wheel is a new breed of omni\-channel digital commerce agency that services brands from "click to ship." Our integrated approach combines front\-end marketing, advertising, and creative services with back\-end operational support and fulfillment across direct\-to\-consumer, eRetail, and marketplace channels.


Our teams help brands grow across today's most important digital commerce platforms by combining deep channel expertise with proprietary technology, including our reporting and analytics platform, Companion. As we continue to expand our direct\-to\-consumer practice, we are looking for an experienced Paid Media Account Manager to join our team.




**The Opportunity**


As a Paid Media Account Manager, you will serve as the primary strategic partner and main point of contact for a portfolio of DTC clients. In this role, you will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the successful execution of paid media strategies that drive growth across channels such as search, social, and programmatic.


This role is highly collaborative and requires strong communication, project management, and strategic thinking skills. While you will work closely with internal specialists across Paid Media, Creative, Analytics, Owned and Earned Marketing, you will be responsible for ensuring all initiatives align with client goals and are delivered effectively.


The ideal candidate has strong experience within the paid media ecosystem and understands how the different components of performance marketing\-campaign strategy, creative, audience targeting, and on\-site experience\-work together to drive results.




**What You'll Do**

**Client LeadershipRelationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of DTC clients, building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor on paid media strategy
* Lead regular client meetings, including performance reviews, strategic discussions, and quarterly business reviews
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication, strategic recommendations, and clear performance insights

**StrategyPerformance Oversight**

* Translate client business goals into actionable paid media strategies across platforms including Google, Meta, TikTok, and other emerging channels
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale, and overall return on investment
* Budget planning and performance forecasting by leveraging historical data, platform insights, and scenario\-based thinking to guide investment decisions and growth strategies
* Connect cross\-functional teams to ensure strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels are aligned, cohesive, and driving toward shared client goals; translate these efforts into clear, digestible, and actionable recommendations
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations based on performance trends, testing results, and platform dynamics
* Stay informed on platform updates and best practices across paid media and the broader digital marketing landscape as well as within the client's industry




**Cross\-Functional CollaborationAccount Growth**

* Coordinate closely with internal teams across Paid Media, Analytics, Creative, etc to ensure successful execution of client strategies
* Manage timelines, priorities, and deliverables across multiple accounts while ensuring work is delivered on schedule
* Identify opportunities to expand services and drive incremental growth for client accounts
* Contribute to internal best practices and knowledge sharing across the Paid Media team
* Proactively identify opportunities to retain and grow client revenue by uncovering gaps, recommending upsells, and introducing new solutions that align with client goals and broader business objectives




**Who You Are**

* A strong communicator who can confidently lead conversations with clients and internal teams
* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects and client priorities simultaneously
* A strategic thinker who understands how paid media levers impact business performance
* Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple teams and stakeholders
* Curious and proactive about evolving trends and opportunities within the digital marketing landscape

**Desired SkillsExperience**

* 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, or eCommerce account management
* Experience developing or contributing to paid media strategies and media plans across platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, and other digital channels; strong understanding of how budget allocation, targeting, and creative drive performance outcomes
* Experience managing or supporting paid media campaigns across search and social
* Previous experience in a client\-facing account management role, ideally within an agency or consulting environment
* Strong understanding of performance marketing including campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance analytics
* Proactive and detail\-oriented, with a strong ability to connect the dots across media, creative, and on\-site performance data to deliver cohesive, actionable insights
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Experience managing budgets, forecasts, and performance reporting preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred
* Agency or consulting experience is strongly preferred

**Blue Wheel operates and hires in the following states: CT, CO, FL, ID, IL, KS, MI, MN, NJ, NY, OR, PA, TN, TX, and WA**

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Partner Inside Sales Representative (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Lakeshore, we create innovative learning materials and world\-class guest experiences for teachers, parents and children. Since 1954, we’ve grown into a global community—with a thriving e\-commerce business, multiple catalogs, over 50 stores, a peerless national sales force, plus international offices that support our preeminent supply chain division. But today we’re working better, smarter and faster than ever—and setting our sights even higher. We’re building an infrastructure designed for scalability, embracing data\-driven decision\-making and using technology to improve efficiency and ensure the best tools for the best work. Most importantly, we continue to invest in a diverse team of inquisitive top talent who fuel each other’s passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.

 **Job Description** **The ideal candidate for the Partner Inside Sales Representative** is enthusiastic about education with a consultative, solution\-based approach to assisting customers. Primary focus on forging relationships and exceeding customers’ expectations. The right candidate has an outgoing personality and thrives on working in a collaborative environment. Strong communication skills will be needed as this role spends most of the day on the phone building lasting customer relationships. This is a fast\-paced and exciting sales role, and you will be tasked with growing new business and achieving sales quotas/daily activity goals. This role is fully remote, so candidates can be based anywhere in the US.

**A day on the job looks like this:**

* Collaborates with Outside Sales team members to drive site\-based customer outreach and key market penetration
* Organized, forwarding thinking, ability to create strong internal and cross\-functional partnerships
* Securing new and repeat business by building strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders via virtual appointments and outbound phone calls
* Consistently meeting, if not exceeding, activity requirements on a regular basis.
* Partnering with schools and childcare centers on a regular basis to assess emerging and ongoing needs
* Hosting virtual product presentations designed to familiarize customers with proprietary services (Complete Classrooms®, professional development, custom solutions, and more)
* Conducting online research to gather information pertaining to local, state and national trends and funding opportunities in early learning and elementary education
* Working with department leadership to form and modify sales strategies
* Partnering with outside sales, retail and our professional services group to support the needs of educators
* Identifying sales leads and collaborating with various members of the sales force to support the market
* Participating in weekly meetings with your team to discuss department initiatives and strategies
* Assisting team on special projects such as partnering with the outside sales force and participating in national and/or state campaigns

  

**Qualifications** **Got the skills and experience? Here is what we’re looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience making high volume outbound sales calls in an Inside Sales and/or Outside Sales role is required
* Preferred qualifications include a strong track record of sales success within the EC and K–5 education sector and deep familiarity with the industry's dynamics and decision\-making processes
* Strong work ethic, team player mentality, and ability to perform outstanding work from home
* Solid presentation skills and ability to speak to customer needs at all levels (teachers, administrators, directors)
* Highly coachable with an eagerness to learn and accept feedback
* Goal oriented and self\-motivated with a personal desire to improve and succeed
* Experience with Salesforce is a plus
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel) preferred
* Top\-notch written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent administrative and organizational skills
* Great attention to detail

  

**Additional Information** **And here’s our end of the bargain!**

* Hourly: $31\.50\-$34\.62
* Uncapped commission structure
* Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding
* Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage—EPO, PPO and HSA
* 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
* Flexible benefit options—choose what you like, ignore the rest
* Generous employee discount on products


At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.


We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it’s a great experience to be part of. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. To help maintain this high bar for success, we’re constantly on the lookout for people to join us. So if you’re a down\-to\-earth professional who shares our desire for making a difference, we’d love to hear from you.


To learn more about Lakeshore, visit www.lakeshorelearning.com/careers

Associate Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Sensormatic Solutions, a Johnson Controls business, helps retailers make smarter decisions through data, analytics, and connected technologies. As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to both new and existing customers, helping them maximize the value of Sensormatic solutions while driving retention, adoption, and growth.

**What we offer**

* **Competitive salary and bonus plan**
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time \- **15 days of vacation first year**
* Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care \- **Available day one**
* Extensive product and on the job/cross training opportunities **with outstanding resources**
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy
* **Check us Out:** **A Day in a Life at Johnson Controls**:

**What you will do**


In this role, you will partner closely with Regional Sales Managers, Mid\-Market Sales Managers, and cross\-functional teams to understand customer objectives, deliver actionable insights, support pilot programs, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with analytical thinking, customer advocacy, and a passion for helping customers succeed.

**How you will do it**
----------------------

* Retain and grow customer revenue through proactive account management, routine business reviews, reporting analysis, user training, and data utilization coaching.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that drive customer satisfaction, reduce attrition risk, and support long\-term partnerships.
* Partner with sales teams before and after the sale to define pilot program objectives, establish success criteria, and support implementation activities.
* Lead customers through pilot evaluations, including field training, adoption strategies, and best\-practice recommendations to support broader deployment opportunities.
* Identify expansion and upsell opportunities by understanding customer business needs and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Conduct regular customer meetings to evaluate business performance, adoption metrics, and future solution requirements.
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise retail customers, including organizations operating 75\+ store locations.
* Serve as the primary customer advocate and collaborate across Solutions, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to address customer needs and improve outcomes.
* Maintain knowledge of Sensormatic solutions, system functionality, and customer\-facing data workflows.
* Support additional leadership initiatives and cross\-functional projects as assigned.
* Demonstrate Johnson Controls values through accountability, customer focus, integrity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**What we look for**
--------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer success, account management, customer service, consulting, or other business\-related roles.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking abilities with experience interpreting customer data and business trends.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted customer relationships and influence stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.
* Flexibility to support occasional evening or weekend business needs.

### **Preferred**

* MBA or advanced business degree.
* Retail industry experience at the store, district, regional, or corporate level.
* Experience supporting enterprise retail accounts.
* Experience driving customer adoption, retention, expansion, or recurring revenue initiatives.
* Familiarity with data analytics, reporting platforms, and customer success best practices.

**HIRING SALARY RANGE: $73,000\-$101,000** (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. ### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**\*\* This role is a Field Based role working in the greater Chicago, IL Market.**

  

  

Primary Function of Position
  

The U.S. ION® Endoluminal Sales Representative (ESR) reports to the U.S. ION® Endoluminal
  

Program Manager (EPM) for the Chicago, IL Territory. The ION® ESR plays a critical role in the early adoption of the Ion®
  

platform in expanding access to minimally invasive care for lung biopsy. This individual will be
  

primarily focused on building and supporting early sustainable users and programs and the
  

development of KOL’s and programs that can highlight the early clinical, economic and strategic
  

value of ION®.


Essential Job Duties
  

* Provide procedural support to new users to promote safety and effective progression through

their learning curves
  

* Work with senior hospital staff and key physicians in the development and execution of a plan to

effectively integrate Ion® at new customer sites, ensuring ongoing commitment to and utilization
  

of the system
  

* Facilitate critical user and procedural data capture to create effective QTI and benchmarking

metrics
  

* Work closely with the ESM and Marketing team to build Ion Catalyst Programs driven through

the clinical, economic and strategic validation and impact of a robust ION® robotic biopsy
  

program
  

* Management of all associated activities to include case observations, training labs, attend first

case series and development of teams and programs
  

* Become a clinical expert in the relative spaces. (Pulmonology, Oncology, Interventional Radiology

and integration of Thoracic Treatment)
  

* Collaboration with daVinci local sales teams, leadership and Key Accounts to ensure consistent

alignment and communication with internal and external stakeholders while implementing
  

market strategy in major MSAs
  

* Responsibly manage administrative tasks, SFDC management, submission of expense reports,

etc.
### **Qualifications**


Required Skills and Experience

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* **A minimum of 5 years of sales experience including 2 or more years in healthcare sales**
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and work in an environment of change
* Proven ability to understand new market dynamics and drive adoption of disruptive technology
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Background in selling medical capital equipment
* Excellent clinical selling skills and ability to quickly develop credibility with a highly educated

customer base
  

**• Ability to travel up to 60% and located near a major airline hub**
  

* Knowledge of the Pulmonology/Bronchoscopy space environment is a plus

**• Bachelor’s degree required**

Since 1984, our nonprofit organization has provided compassionate support that empowers families to achieve lasting stability and self\-sufficiency through housing programs, essential services like our food pantry and career counseling, and meaningful resources that nurture resilience and hope. Guided by our core values of dignity, empowerment, accountability, community spirit, and hope, we strive to create an environment where families can thrive and where every team member feels inspired, valued, and equipped to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others. new_jobs.title: Program Specialist (Aptos Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach)
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Specialist (Middle School Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach)**

**Salary:****$26\-$30 per hour, plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator**

**Status:****Full Time (30 hours/week); Non\-Exempt (Position ends 6/2/2027\)**

 **POSITION DESCRIPTION**


Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist (Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach) is responsible for providing academic tutoring, educational support and behavioral coaching to youth during the school day and in after school programs. The position is responsible for tutoring middle school aged students in core academic classes such as English, Math, Science, Social Studies, etc. The position may also support a variety of enrichment activities as needed.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide one\-on\-one and group academic tutoring in core subject areas and behavioral coaching to students.
* Collaborate and coordinate with school day teachers, counselors, and beacon staff to identify high needs students who need educational support.
* Provide 1:1 light case management to students who need social emotional learning and behavioral health support.
* Provide training and support to high school volunteer tutors as needed.
* Create incentive plans to encourage student engagement and retention.
* Develop and support a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for youth as needed.
* Support with outreach and marketing strategies to recruit and retain youth programs.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Work collaboratively with the school leadership team, community partners, and faculty to design and align programs to support the school’s goals for student development, academic achievement, social and emotional learning.
* Make contact with parents/caregivers in a professional and consistent manner to advise parents on youths' progress and challenges.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested by funders and supervisor.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields preferred plus 2 years of proven experience in youth development or experience in providing academic support.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with diverse youth and families is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills (both oral and written).
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multi\-task, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs \& sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Cantonese/Mandarin, or Arabic is a plus.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

  

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.
