new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cancer Immunotherapy Research & Clinical Translation Program
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join the Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation (CIRCT) Program within the Division of Hematology/Oncology.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager and/or the Principal Investigator (PI). The incumbent will coordinate the operations and data collection of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies (sponsored, cooperative group, and investigator\-initiated studies), depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; assist with training of Assistant CRCs help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; assist in maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.  

  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is a national leader in oncology research. The Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation program is a fast paced program with a broad portfolio of clinical trials. The mission of the UCSF HDFCC Oncology Program is to provide patients and their families with streamlined access to cutting\-edge cancer therapies, In addition to providing compassionate, patient\-centered care, our team of clinicians and researchers is dedicated to improving outcomes for all patients.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Familiarity with specimen processing, or demonstrated ability to learn specimen processing in a laboratory environment
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Ability to work across several different programs, reporting to 2\-3 different supervisors
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences.
* Exceptional database management experience and prior experience with various computer programs (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore.
* Experience with medical charts and electronic records
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day. May need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle. Ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of, or demonstrated ability to learn federal, state, and local research regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team oriented environment

Preferred Qualifications:


* Bachelor's degree with a major in science or related
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials and experience with Phase I\-III trials
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:



	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

new_jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a friendly, outgoing, Japanese\-speaking team member to help us create food, cultural, fandom, gaming, and entertainment experiences in the Bay Area.

This is a hands\-on role that combines Japanese community and brand relationships, event coordination, hosting, food, games, fandom, and social media.

You will help communicate with Japanese brands and partners, coordinate community and fandom events, work with vendors and collaborators, interact with guests, and represent our company both in person and online.

Professional event or marketing experience is not required. We are especially interested in people who are personable, reliable, curious, and excited to learn.

This could be a great fit for someone looking for flexible part\-time work, including parents, semi\-retired professionals, students, freelancers, or people pursuing other creative projects.

What You’ll Do

Japanese Community \& Brand Relationships

* Communicate with Japanese\-speaking brands, businesses, restaurants, food companies, creators, and cultural organizations
* Help build and maintain relationships with Japanese brands and partners both locally and internationally
* Communicate with partners in Japanese through email, messaging, and other channels
* Assist with outreach to potential vendors, sponsors, collaborators, and brand partners
* Coordinate product samples, brand activations, collaborations, and other partnership details
* Research interesting Japanese brands, products, trends, and potential collaborations

Events \& Community Programming

* Help plan and execute food, cultural, fandom, gaming, and entertainment events
* Coordinate with fan communities, creators, performers, vendors, and community organizations
* Help organize games, tournaments, watch parties, screenings, demonstrations, meetups, and other interactive events
* Assist with event setup, check\-in, activities, hosting, food service, and breakdown
* Help make events welcoming, organized, and fun for guests

Hosting \& Social Media

* Welcome guests and interact with customers in a warm and engaging way
* Host games, activities, tastings, demonstrations, and other event programming
* Appear in photos and videos for Instagram, TikTok, and other social media
* Participate in short\-form videos, interviews, demonstrations, and event content
* Help create fun and approachable content around Japanese culture, food, games, fandom, and events

Food \& Hands\-On Event Work

* Assist with food preparation, tastings, demonstrations, setup, serving, and cleanup
* Work with food brands, restaurants, chefs, and vendors
* Help research and develop food\-related event concepts
* Introduce guests to new foods, products, and experiences

Required Qualifications

* Fluent spoken Japanese
* Strong Japanese reading and writing ability
* Able to communicate comfortably in English
* Friendly, approachable, and comfortable talking with new people
* Comfortable appearing on social media and in front of a camera
* Reliable and responsible
* Willing to learn and take initiative
* Comfortable with hands\-on event work and changing priorities
* Able to work some evenings and weekends when events require it

Experience \& Skills

Professional experience is not required. We welcome candidates from a variety of backgrounds.

Experience in any of the following is a plus:

* Japanese food, restaurants, cooking, baking, catering, or hospitality
* Event coordination or event production
* Hosting, theater, performance, presenting, or public speaking
* Social media or content creation
* Anime, manga, video games, board games, or fandom communities
* Japanese cultural organizations or community groups
* Working with Japanese companies or brands
* Marketing, partnerships, or community management

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

You might be a great fit if you:

* Love Japanese food and culture
* Enjoy anime, games, fandom, or entertainment
* Like meeting new people and making guests feel welcome
* Are naturally curious and enjoy discovering new brands and products
* Are comfortable communicating with both Japanese and English\-speaking partners
* Don’t mind being on camera
* Enjoy a job where every day can be a little different
* Are looking for flexible work that combines people, culture, food, and events

We care more about finding the right personality, Japanese communication skills, and willingness to learn than having a perfect resume.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Golden State Dermatology is a physician\-led and owned dermatology group rapidly expanding across California. We are a leading medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology group specializing in skin, hair, and nail conditions, Mohs micrographic surgery for the treatment of skin cancer, surgical and non\-surgical cosmetic skincare, anti\-aging, body contouring, and plastic surgery.

  

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the conduct of clinical trials under the direction of the Principal Investigator and research leadership. This position is responsible for coordinating assigned studies and ensuring study activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with study protocols, ICH\-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and institutional requirements.

  

The Coordinator works closely with study participants, investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other research staff. Responsibilities include study start\-up and regulatory activities, participant recruitment and study visits, source documentation and EDC entry, safety reporting, study supply management, monitoring visit preparation, and study close\-out.

  

This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication, and problem\-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities and proactively identify and escalate study\-related issues. Frequent travel to the Walnut Creek study site is required.

 **Essential Responsibilities**  

**Study Start\-Up \& Regulatory**

* Support study feasibility and start\-up activities.
* Review study protocols and study materials to understand operational requirements.
* Prepare and maintain regulatory documents, including IRB submissions, amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Maintain regulatory binders and essential study documents.
* Complete study\-specific training and maintain required training documentation.
* Assist with preparation for site initiation visits, monitoring visits, sponsor visits, audits, and inspections.
* Perform study activities in accordance with ICH\-GCP, FDA regulations, study protocols, and applicable institutional requirements.

 **Study Conduct \& Coordination**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities for assigned clinical studies.
* Communicate with investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other study personnel regarding assigned study activities.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
new_jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

### **About the Role**


As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest\-velocity, highest\-volume post\-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands\-on customer impact \- driving excellence in post\-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast\-moving book of accounts.


This is a revenue\-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first \- more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high\-volume book of business.
* Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate \- building a team culture where expansions and cross\-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota\-carrying sales function.
* Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
* Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
* Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI\-powered approaches to their work.
* Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
* Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post\-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high\-volume, transactional or corporate\-segment books of business.
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
* 2\+ years of direct people leadership experience \- managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high\-performance, feedback\-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
* Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
* Strong player\-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
* Expertise in post\-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high\-volume, scaled motion.

Look for opportunities to reshare audience and partner content, and use platform features such as collaborative posts and event listings where they can help extend reach. Develop sharing kits when useful and encourage artists, institutions, and other participants to amplify campaigns through their own channels.

Respond to comments and messages, forwarding sales\-related inquiries to gallery staff for follow\-up.

**Social Listening and Content Curation**  
Rather than treating Haines Gallery’s accounts as a one\-way broadcast channel, stay attuned to what is happening online around the gallery, its artists, and the broader art community. Use social listening tools to monitor artists’ accounts, partner organizations, cultural conversations, and other relevant social channels to identify exhibition coverage, user\-generated content, and opportunities for engagement. Curate appropriate external content for resharing, including relevant arts\-related content beyond the gallery’s own artists and exhibitions.

**Analytics and Reporting**  
Track social media performance across platforms, including audience growth, engagement, reach, and campaign effectiveness. Prepare and present periodic reports on key trends and insights, and make recommendations to gallery leadership to refine strategy and improve campaign performance.

**ABOUT YOU**

Successful candidates will have experience using Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Hootsuite, or comparable tools for content creation, scheduling, and social media management. The ability to produce engaging video content is essential, as are strong organizational, writing, and communication skills. Candidates should be responsive to direction while also being comfortable working independently. Experience managing social media and community engagement in the visual arts is preferred.

**Please send resume, cover letter, and work samples to David Spalding at david@hainesgallery.com by September 20, 2026\. No phone inquiries. Selected candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.**

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

Experience:

* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail

new_jobs.description:
**Department:** General \& Administrative  

**Location:** Oakland, CA  


***Lincoln Families is a workplace that is committed to strengths\-based, culturally responsive, attachment\-centered, and trauma\-informed care.***

  

  

**JOB TITLE:** Executive Assistant


**SALARY:** $75,000 \- $80,000 annually


**POSITION SUMMARY:** Reporting directly to the President \& CEO, the Executive Assistant provides a wide variety of skilled administrative, clerical and executive\-level support for CEO and other Senior Management Team (SMT) members. This position is the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on all matters pertaining to the Office of the CEO which includes, but is not limited to, screening calls, mail and other inquiries and communicating on behalf of CEO and/or SMT. As the most senior administrative position in the Agency, responsibilities involve exposure to sensitive information and require considerable use of tact, diplomacy, discretion and judgment. The Executive Assistant serves as a liaison to the Board of Directors, attends Board or similar meetings to take, transcribe and distribute minutes, prepares Board packets, and coordinates all logistical details. This position also researches or analyzes data and develops reports for management decision\-making and oversees special projects.

  

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


* Perform a wide variety of executive\-level secretarial and administrative duties as required by daily operations in the CEO’s office.
* Develop and recommend office procedures and systems that coordinate activities and schedules, and ensure smooth operations.
* Research and analyze routine administrative projects for the CEO; prepare first draft reports on routine administrative matters.
* Independently create forms, reports manuals, filing systems and the like in order to facilitate completion of Agency business.
* Apply knowledge to gathering information from a variety of resources such as manuals, documentation, consultation with content experts in resolving technical issues and improving processes or operations.
* Research and document background materials for CEO projects.
* Receive and screen communications to the CEO including telephone calls and e\-mail messages, and provide assistance using independent judgment to determine those requiring priority attention; prioritize, channel, and facilitate communication through the CEO’s office.
* Receive and distribute incoming mail for the CEO; review and evaluate mail to identify those items requiring priority attention of the CEO. Independently respond to letters and general correspondence of a routine nature.
* Provide follow up to assignments given to management staff by the CEO/SMT and report status to the CEO/SMT.
* Create charts, graphs, spreadsheets, memos, reports and presentations. Prepare and submit expense reports and other administrative duties as required.
* Maintain appointment schedules and manage CEO’s calendar; this includes scheduling requested meetings, calls and/or conferences and making travel arrangements as needed.
* Provide support for meetings by preparing agendas, summaries and handouts; order refreshments or food and arrange meeting locations.
* Attend weekly SMT, bi\-monthly Board meetings, monthly Board committee meetings and other assigned meetings to take minutes and maintain required documentation. This responsibility includes assisting when requested to prepare and distribute agendas and other materials or coordinating logistics required for meeting (e.g., audio/visual equipment, room reservations) in a timely fashion.
* Manage an efficient file systems and/or databases vital to Agency operations such as private sector agreements and contracts, licenses, permits and various attachments; assures availability and provides this information as needed (e.g., for accreditation and audit purposes).
* Coordinate and help manage special events such as annual All Staff Celebration, special employee activities or meetings, etc.
* Support Board and Board Committees, maintain document files and archive as necessary; maintain web\-based Board portal.
* Manage the process for Restorative Justice facilitators including contracts and scheduling.
* Track and report progress on agency\-wide policies, procedures and strategic plan; this includes communicating with SMT and Board members to stay within timelines.

  

  

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:** The Executive Assistant must be highly motivated and enjoy working within a non\-profit environment that is mission\-driven, community\-based and results\-oriented. Will be a positive, service\-focused team player who is able to work independently in a fast\-paced work environment and manage priorities effectively under the pressure of sometimes competing deadlines. Must have the ability to exercise sound judgment and quick thinking in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with staff members and stakeholders at all levels with cultural humility. Maintains the highest level of confidentiality, has exceptional organizational skills, and exhibits a continuous improvement mentality with the ability to design and implement administrative systems and procedures. Must be able to problem\-solve and maintain composure and poise while handling crises effectively, be willing to adapt in ever\-changing environment and demonstrate high reliability and stability in long\-term commitment. The Executive Assistant must be extremely flexible in schedule/availability as this position may require an extended workday, including late evenings and weekends.

  

  

**EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**


* Bachelor’s degree required (equivalent experience may be considered)
* At least 3 years of experience as administrative assistant with progressive responsibilities; previous experience at the Executive Assistant level is preferred
* Experience working with Board of Directors is

new_jobs.title: Program Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).


The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.


We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.


Primary Location:


CUNY SCHOOL OF PROFESSIONAL STUDIES
Bargaining Unit:


No


**About the CUNY School of Professional Studies:**

As a leading online school in New York since 2006, the CUNY School of Professional Studies (CUNY SPS) offers the most online bachelor's and master's degree options at the City University of New York, and serves as the University's first undergraduate all\-transfer college. With 26 degrees and numerous other non\-degree and grant\-funded workplace learning programs, CUNY SPS meets the needs of adults who wish to finish a bachelor's degree, progress from an associate's degree, earn a master's degree or certificate in a specialized field, and advance in the workplace or change careers. Consistently ranked highly by U.S. News \& World Report for its online offerings, CUNY SPS has emerged as a nationwide leader in online education. The School's renowned and affordable online programs ensure that busy working adults may fulfill their educational goals on their own time and schedule. As CUNY SPS moves beyond its’ 20th year, we dedicate ourselves to engendering an innovative and transformative student\-centered experience.  



Within and created at the same time as CUNY SPS, the Office of Innovative Learning Solutions (ILS) designs custom workplace learning programs to help organizations achieve their goals. We are experts in research\-based learning practices, online as well as in\-classroom curriculum development and implementation. We are uniquely positioned to respond to organizational learning needs and support change management initiatives swiftly and effectively.


**Partnership Description:**

CUNY SPS partners with the Department of Social Services (DSS) Office of Policy, Procedures \& Training (OPPT) to support the Department of Homeless Services (DHS) by creating and managing a comprehensive learning program to support DHS and DHS provider staff as they work to address, reduce, and ultimately prevent homelessness in New York City. Specifically, the program (1\) writes procedures to support shelter operations and (2\) creates learning resources to train DHS and DHS provider staff on operational processes and city\-mandated topics.


**Position Description:**

The Program Operations Specialist reports to the Deputy Director of Program Management and manages enrollment, scheduling, logistics, learner support, LMS administration, and operational reporting across training programs.  



**Position Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage setup, maintenance, and content uploads for e\-learning, Instructor\-Led Training (ILT), Virtual Instructor\-Led Training (VILT), and curriculum offerings within the Learning Management System (LMS).
* Conduct final quality assurance and readiness activities for courses and curricula within the LMS.
* Manage end\-to\-end enrollment processes for course offerings.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate logistics for ILT and VILT sessions.
* Execute pre\-launch review and launch preparation activities, including, but not limited to:



	+ Partner with Curriculum Developers and stakeholders to coordinate launch strategy
	+ Communicate with learners (where applicable)
	+ Coordinate with stakeholders to define the pre\-launch review or launch audience to set up in the LMS
	+ Create pre\-launch review and launch level 1 evaluation links and QR codes (eventually will include level 3\)
	+ Set up level 2 pre\- and post\-training assessments in the LMS
* Support ILT classroom preparation and readiness.
* Manage production and distribution of course materials in print and digital formats.
* Track and manage attendance for ILT and VILT sessions.
* Produce and distribute stakeholder reports on enrollment, attendance, and learning outcomes for ILT and VILT.
* Maintain and update monthly training metrics within reporting platforms.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for training inquiries and learner support.
* Support the development, testing, and implementation of operational solutions and process improvements that strengthen the Program Management function.
* Lead special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

Minimum requirements for the position:


* Education and experience for one of the following:



	+ A bachelor's degree with three (3\) years of full\-time experience directly related to program coordination supporting large\-scale learning or professional development programs.
	+ An associate’s degree with four (4\) years of full\-time experience with program coordination supporting large\-scale learning or professional development programs.
* Experience utilizing learning management systems and reporting platforms to support learning programs.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities to independently resolve routine and complex issues.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to present information effectively to diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to keep accurate records.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with program partners, facilitators, and learners.
* Ability to take initiative and perform work both independently and collaboratively.
* Competence in adapting to changing situations and priorities.
* Strong computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).

The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating purchase orders and inbound logistics activities from PO issuance through delivery of goods to the warehouse. This role will work closely with internal teams, vendors, freight forwarders, and warehouse partners to ensure timely and accurate shipment execution.

MIH Systems Group is a growing company in the HVAC services field, and we work to make buildings work better. We specialize in optimizing complex HVAC systems in buildings. Our diverse team delivers value to our clients from the design stages of new construction through the operation of existing buildings. Our HVAC service team provides start\-up services for complex HVAC equipment from a wide range of manufacturers, as well as ongoing preventive maintenance, break/fix repair, and equipment retrofit services. Our Ambient team includes experienced professionals who focus on cost\-effective solutions for our clients.

  

  

**Job Description**  



**MIH Systems Group** is hiring an Administrator to support back\-office and executive operations across our New York business lines. This is a broad, hands\-on role combining HR/payroll administration, customer and billing support, travel logistics, and direct executive assistant support to the Vice President and Operations Director. It's well\-suited to someone who is detail\-obsessed, comfortable handling sensitive financial and personnel information, and energized by supporting multiple business lines at once rather than a single narrow function.


This role is a coordination/conduit function, not a decision\-owning one: the Administrator submits payroll, requests COIs, and routes customer paperwork, rather than administering payroll or the insurance program itself. That keeps the required seniority consistent across the role's responsibilities — this should be priced and titled as a coordinator\-level position, not an HR/benefits\-specialist role.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Submit payroll data on behalf of staff each cycle (manual process until automated)
* Serve as the point of contact between the team and payroll provider, ensuring timely and accurate submission
* Request certificates of insurance (COIs) from the broker for projects, vendors, and contracts as needed
* Track COI requests through to completion and maintain records for project files
* Collect client information (W\-9\), and set up them up in our business systems
* Support billing and invoicing workflows; assist with accounts receivable follow\-up as needed
* Book employee travel per existing SOP (refundable fares, corporate travel accounts)
* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for field engineers and leadership travel
* Provide direct administrative support to the Vice President and Operations Director, including calendar management, correspondence, and task follow\-up
* Assist with document preparation and light project coordination as needed
* Serve as a central administrative point of contact across business units
* Handle administrative projects as priorities shift across business lines

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of administrative or coordinator experience; exposure to payroll submission, insurance/COI requests, or customer onboarding processes a plus (not required to have owned these functions)
* Comfortable handling confidential financial and personnel data with discretion
* Strong follow\-through — this role is a conduit between the team and outside parties (payroll provider, insurance broker, customers), so nothing can fall through the cracks
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units
* Knowledge of HVAC/Construction background is preferred
* Experience with Dynamic365, CRM systems, or similar business platforms a plus
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work on\-site in New York, NY

new_jobs.title: Vendor Operations Associate

Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C\-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

  

End users enjoy a seamless, zero\-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all\-in\-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

  

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

  

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and \[solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry\-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

 **About the Role**


Order.co is looking for a Vendor Operations Associate to help ensure orders are fulfilled successfully/reconciled accurately, vendors are operating within our processes, and operational issues are resolved quickly and effectively.

  

This is an entry\-level role ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, investigating issues, and working with people. You'll spend your day monitoring orders, identifying roadblocks, collaborating with vendors and teammates, and ensuring customers receive a seamless experience.

  

The role sits within our Vendor Operations organization and works closely with Accounts Payable, Fulfillment Operations, Customer Success, and our offshore operations team.

  

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is not required.

 **What You'll Do**

**Keep Orders Moving**

* Proactively investigate outstanding orders to ensure they are progressing toward fulfillment
* Identify and resolve operational issues that could delay order completion
* Monitor workflows and follow up on orders requiring additional attention
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customers receive a smooth fulfillment experience

**Work Directly with Vendors**

* Communicate with vendors to resolve order issues, payment issues, and fulfillment questions

* Identify recurring vendor behaviors that create operational challenges and work toward long\-term solutions

**Support Payment \& Operational Resolution**

* Investigate payment failures and help coordinate resolution efforts
* Assist with invoice and payment\-related workflows when needed
* Escalate issues appropriately and ensure follow\-through until resolution
* Help identify root causes behind recurring operational and payment issues

**Drive Continuous Improvement**

* Look for patterns and recurring issues across vendors, orders, and workflows
* Suggest improvements that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
* Collaborate with offshore team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Contribute to process documentation and operational best practices

 **What We're Looking For**

* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to stay organized while managing multiple priorities
* Comfortable solving problems independently and asking questions when needed
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Experience with spreadsheets, email, and business software is helpful but not required

 **Why This Role Matters**


Every day, thousands of orders flow through the Order.co platform. While many are automated, some require investigation, coordination, and problem solving to ensure successful completion.

  

This role serves as a critical bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams, helping ensure orders are fulfilled, vendors remain compliant with our processes, and operational issues are resolved before they impact the customer experience.

  

It's an opportunity to develop valuable skills in operations, vendor management, procurement, accounts payable, and process improvement while making an immediate impact on the business.

**What You'll Receive**

* Employer\-sponsored 401(k) with employer match

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Brooklyn, NY - 2027
new_jobs.description:
**Launch Your Sales Career at Topline Pro**
===========================================


We don't think a sales job should just teach you how to hit a number. It should teach you how to become great at sales. That's what this role is built to do.


As a BDR at Topline Pro, you'll join a team designed around learning, coaching, competition, and growth. You'll learn how to prospect, run discovery, demo our product, manage a pipeline, negotiate, and close business. More importantly, you'll learn how to take feedback, diagnose where you're getting stuck, and continuously get better at your craft.


You don't need years of sales experience to be successful here. We're much more interested in how you learn, how hard you're willing to work at something, how you respond when things don't go your way, and how much ownership you take over your own development.


In return, we're going to invest heavily in you.


You'll get regular coaching, role plays, call reviews, structured training, and a manager whose job isn't just to inspect your number, but to help you become a better seller. As you prove you're ready for more, you'll have opportunities to take on more responsibility and continue growing your career at Topline Pro.

**Growth here isn't about waiting your turn. It's about showing you're ready.**

**What the job actually looks like**
====================================


This is a high\-energy, high\-expectation sales environment. You'll be in our Williamsburg office five days a week, surrounded by people who want to get better and want the people around them to get better too. Our office is dog\-friendly and in the historic Domino Sugar Refinery at Domino Park.


You'll:

* Prospect home service business owners through high\-volume calling, email, and other outreach.
* Learn how to run great discovery conversations and understand what actually matters to a small business owner.
* Demo Topline Pro and connect our product to the problems you're hearing.
* Manage your own pipeline and learn how to move opportunities from first conversation through close.
* Participate regularly in coaching, role plays, call reviews, and team training.
* Get direct feedback and be expected to put it into practice quickly.
* Learn from your teammates, share what's working, and contribute to making the entire team better.
* Use our CRM and sales tools consistently to manage follow\-ups, prioritize opportunities, and stay organized.
* Learn how to use technology and AI to work smarter and become a more effective seller.
* Own your results. We'll give you coaching, tools, support, and opportunity, but what you do with them is up to you.

**Who tends to thrive here**
============================


We're less concerned with whether you've sold SaaS before and more interested in the person you're becoming. You'll probably love this environment if:

* **You want to get really good at something.** You're not just looking for your next job. You want to build skills and a career.
* **You're coachable.** You don't just listen to feedback. You try it, practice it, and come back better.
* **You're competitive with yourself.** You care about winning, but you're especially motivated by seeing yourself improve.
* **You're resilient.** Sales involves rejection. A bad call, bad day, or bad week doesn't change how you show up tomorrow.
* **You're curious.** You ask questions, want to understand why something works, and aren't satisfied memorizing a script.
* **You work hard.** There's no shortcut around the reps required to become great at sales.
* **You take ownership.** When something isn't working, your first instinct is to figure out what you can do differently.
* **You're a great teammate.** We compete, but not at each other's expense. We share what's working, help each other improve, and celebrate when someone else wins.
* **You're comfortable with change.** We're a fast\-growing company and we're constantly learning. Processes, messaging, and priorities will evolve as we get better.
* **You communicate well.** You can build trust with small business owners and communicate in a way that's clear, professional, and human.


Previous sales experience is helpful, but it isn't required. We're looking for people with the raw ingredients to become great sellers and the willingness to put in the work to get there.

**Where this can take you**
===========================


We want ambitious people.


This role is meant to build the foundation for a career in sales, and we want Topline Pro to be a place where you can keep building that career.


As you demonstrate mastery of the role, you'll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility, work more complex opportunities, and continue progressing as a seller.


We don't believe career growth should happen simply because you've been here long enough. **Opportunity is earned by showing you're ready for it.**


If you're looking for a comfortable job where you can blend into the middle of the pack, this probably won't be the right environment.


If you're looking for a place that will challenge you, coach you, invest in you, and give you the opportunity to grow faster than you thought possible, we'd love to meet you.

**Hiring Process**
==================


Our interview process is designed to get to know you beyond your resume and give you a chance to get to know us too. We'll be looking for the same qualities throughout the process that we value once you're here: curiosity, coachability, resilience, ownership, communication, and a genuine desire to grow.

* Recruiter Screen
* Sales Manager Screen
* Roleplay
* Leadership Screen

**What we offer**
=================

* $55k base salary with uncapped commissions ($100k\+ OTE) \+ equity package
* Full Medical, Dental, and Vision Health Coverage
* Computer and workspace enhancements
* 401(k) plan (non\-matching)
* Unlimited vacation, 9 company holidays, including election day, and 1 personal volunteer day a year
* Company\-paid Wellhu

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT REPAY
  

REPAY (“Realtime Electronic Payments” / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast\-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.


ABOUT THE ROLE


REPAY is seeking an Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) to serve as a trusted technical advisor to our strategic enterprise clients. The eTAM will own the ongoing technical relationship with an assigned portfolio of complex clients, developing a deep understanding of their technical environments, integrations, payment workflows, and business priorities.


This highly visible, client\-facing role partners closely with clients and internal teams to ensure the ongoing performance and success of REPAY solutions. The eTAM will provide technical guidance, manage complex technical issues and escalations, **and help clients optimize and expand their use of REPAY's technology.**

The eTAM will work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, and Sales to advocate for client needs and drive successful outcomes.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor and key point of contact for assigned enterprise clients, developing a strong understanding of their business needs, technical environments, and use of REPAY solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions.
* Provide technical guidance and consultation to clients throughout the lifecycle of the relationship, helping them navigate REPAY's products, capabilities, and integrations.
* Partner with clients and internal teams to understand technical needs, identify solutions, and support successful outcomes.
* Proactively identify potential technical risks, challenges, and opportunities within assigned client relationships and help drive appropriate action.
* Coordinate and support the resolution of complex technical issues and client escalations, engaging the appropriate internal resources as needed.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, Sales, and other teams to address client needs and priorities.
* Serve as an advocate for enterprise clients internally, helping communicate client feedback, business needs, technical requirements, and emerging priorities.
* Support the adoption and ongoing success of REPAY products and solutions within assigned enterprise accounts.
* Provide technical insight and support for client discussions, strategic initiatives, new opportunities, and evolving business needs.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen REPAY's enterprise client experience, technical account management practices, and internal processes.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge of REPAY's products, technology, integrations, and industry trends to effectively advise and support clients.
* Perform other responsibilities and support strategic initiatives as needed based on evolving client and business needs.
* Rotating assignment for technical off\-hours on\-call support of our strategic enterprise accounts.

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE NEEDED**

* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Engineering, or a similar client\-facing technical role.
* Experience supporting enterprise or complex clients within a SaaS, fintech, payments, or technology environment.
* Strong understanding of API\-based integrations, including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, and system\-to\-system integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex technical issues and coordinate resolution across multiple technical teams.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, integrations, and workflows.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with both technical stakeholders and senior business leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients, initiatives, escalations, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive, ownership\-oriented approach.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and Account Management organizations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience within payments, fintech, financial services technology, or another highly integrated transaction\-processing environment.
* Knowledge of payment processing concepts, including card and ACH transaction flows, payment gateways, settlement, reconciliation, tokenization, and payment security.
* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools such as Postman.
* Familiarity with SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, or similar technical troubleshooting methods.
* Experience supporting high\-volume, mission\-critical platforms or complex enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS and other security or compliance requirements applicable to payment proce

new_jobs.description:
* 2026
* Alpharetta, Georgia
* Client Service
* full\-time
* Works from an office location
* 16
* USD $106,000\.00/Yr.
* USD $173,000\.00/Yr.


  
**Job Description**
-------------------


Established nearly two centuries ago, FM is a leading mutual insurance company whose capital, scientific research capability and engineering expertise are solely dedicated to property risk management and the resilience of its policyholder\-owners. These owners, who share the belief that the majority of property loss is preventable, represent many of the world’s largest organizations, including one of every four Fortune 500 companies. They work with FM to better understand the hazards that can impact their business continuity to make cost\-effective risk management decisions, combining property loss prevention with insurance protection.


FM's Atlanta, Georgia Operation has an opening for a dynamic Account Manager in our Client Service Department. This position will perform insurance servicing and underwriting activities on existing accounts and new business. This position's primary function is to serve as the account team leader or manager of the account. Serve as key/primary interface with clients/brokers on all aspects of the account including insurance products and services, engineering, and claims services.


**This position is for an AM I to AM II, depending on the level of the candidate’s skill and experience. Varying levels of experience and qualifications will be considered.**


* Maintain a profitable book of business by effective use of sales techniques, client relationships, risk assessments, application of sound underwriting principles and creative use of underwriting resources.
* Ensure premium growth by retaining existing clients through value added service, by selling additional product lines and by establishing equitable terms and conditions on new accounts introduced by sales executives. Ensure policies accurately reflect both the insured’s and FM's intent of coverage.
* Provide professional advice and consultation to all clients on insurance coverages and risk management matters making them aware of the benefits derived from various products and services offered by FM.
* In coordination with Account Engineers, establish risk improvement priorities and support efforts to acquire client compliance with loss prevention recommendations.
* Protect FM's assets through creative use of company underwriting programs and adherence to published guidelines which include: Line setting techniques, judicious purchase of reinsurance (where warranted), timely issuance of policies, catastrophe aggregate analysis, MFL analysis and cross liability checks.
* Collect outstanding premium balances in a timely manner to meet the Operation’s goals and objectives.
* Continue professional development including maintaining necessary licensing. Continue to update knowledge of underwriting guidelines, policy forms, loss prevention practices and insurance industry developments.
* Provide leadership to the overall FM account team, ensuring that the Client Service Process is implemented effectively and efficiently.
* Handle change by prioritizing routine activities, workloads, and projects and through delegating to support staff as necessary.
* Evaluate manuscript coverage/wording requests: analyze existing policy language; degree and type of exposure; pricing; and develop additional policy language if warranted.

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; CPCU or ARM desired!
* Minimum 5\+ years FM experience or 5\+ years industry experience (broker, insurance, reinsurance company) in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* FM loss prevention engineering background desired.
* Previous experience as an Underwriter for FM is desired.
* Power Generation Loss Prevention or Underwriting experience is desired.
* Demonstrated effectiveness at accessing and influencing the decision maker.
* Strong familiarity with FM's client service process preferred.
* Experience in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* Working knowledge of property insurance and forms, financial statements, general loss prevention engineering terms and concepts as well as business computer applications.
* Demonstrated above average ability in organization, problem solving, sales/negotiation, leadership and team building skills.
* Knowledge of internal systems and Microsoft Office products.

The final salary offer will vary based on geographic location, individual education, skills, and experience. The position is eligible to participate in FM’s comprehensive Total Rewards program that includes an incentive plan, generous health, and well\-being programs, a 401(k) and pension plan, career development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, flexible work, time off allowances, and much more!


FM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce.

* Experience in supporting Lowe's, The Home Depot, or another major national retailer is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator
new_jobs.description:
About the Role

Melo Vision Media is looking for a Bilingual Content Creator / Social Media Assistant to join our growing team in the Atlanta area.

This is a paid, flexible position focused mainly on helping us create content for our local clients. You’ll be our on\-the\-ground support in Atlanta, while our remote team handles social media strategy, graphic design, editing, scheduling, and overall marketing.

Most of our clients are restaurants and hospitality\-based businesses, so we’re looking for someone who is creative, outgoing, comfortable working with clients, and understands how to capture content that feels natural and engaging on social media.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your main responsibility will be attending content shoots for different clients throughout the month. Depending on our schedule, this may be around 1–2 shoots per week, with the amount of work varying as we add new clients.

You’ll be responsible for:

* Filming short\-form content for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, etc.
* Taking photos and capturing additional behind\-the\-scenes content when needed.
* Coming to shoots prepared with content ideas and helping direct what we capture.
* Communicating directly with clients to coordinate shoot dates, times, and availability.
* Uploading and organizing all footage into our shared folders after each shoot so our remote team can edit and publish it.
* Occasionally attending meetings or introductions with new clients.
* Becoming a reliable local point of contact for Melo Vision Media and our Atlanta\-area clients.

What We’re Looking For

Bilingual Spanish \+ English is required. This is one of the most important requirements for the position since many of our clients are Spanish\-speaking and/or Latin American businesses.

Being familiar with South American/Latin American culture is a big plus, especially since several of our restaurant clients are South American. We want someone who understands the culture, food, humor, hospitality, and customer experience enough to create content that feels authentic.

You should also:

* Have your own reliable transportation and be comfortable driving to different client locations.
* Have an iPhone with a good\-quality camera for filming content.
* Have access to a computer to upload and organize large photo/video files.
* Be comfortable communicating directly with business owners and clients.
* Be outgoing, responsible, organized, and creative.
* Understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and current social media trends.
* Be comfortable working independently during shoots.

Locations

Our current shoots are primarily around:

Suwanee **Lawrenceville**  Monroe **Smyrna**  Atlanta

Because locations vary depending on the client, reliable transportation is essential.

Schedule \& Pay

This is a flexible, paid position rather than a traditional 9–5 role. The number of shoots may vary from week to week depending on our client schedule.

Compensation will be discussed based on availability, experience, and the number of shoots assigned.

There is also room for the position to grow as Melo Vision Media takes on more clients. Over time, we’d love for this person to become our right hand in Atlanta for content creation and local client relationships.

If you love social media, enjoy creating content, are comfortable working with people, and want hands\-on experience working with different brands and businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Pay: From $15\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30303

* Execute territory\-based community outreach plans aligned with organizational growth and referral goals

* Identify, prospect, and develop new referral source opportunities to strengthen the local pipeline and expand territory reach
* Maintain regular in\-person outreach activity across the territory to ensure consistent visibility, relationship development, and local market presence

new_jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us**


Family Entertainment Group (FEG), is a recognized industry leader in designing, developing, and operating world\-class family entertainment centers and amusement experiences. With a commitment to innovation and guest satisfaction, FEG partners with top brands and venues to create memorable experiences for families and guests of all ages. The Company provides turnkey outsourced facility management and arcade operations services for resorts, hotels, casinos, and amusement parks. Additionally, the Company owns and operates standalone family entertainment centers under the In The Game, Max Action, and Bonkers brands. The Company operates nearly 90 locations throughout the U.S.

**Position Summary**


The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the hands\-on, point\-to\-point movement of shipments and equipment across all Family Entertainment Group locations, including obtaining freight quotes directly from manufacturers and setting up and coordinating wrap\-and\-roll freight for asset transfers. This is an individual\-contributor role: the Coordinator executes logistics tasks directly , and reports to the Parts \& Service Manager. When logistics volume allows, which is the minority of the role, the Coordinator also supports the Parts \& Service department with picking, packing, and shipping parts, fielding service calls, and general department assistance.

**Key Responsibilities – Logistics (Primary)**

* Coordinate all point\-to\-point logistics for shipments, equipment, and assets moving between manufacturers, corporate, and field locations.
* Obtain and compare freight quotes directly from manufacturers for shipments to individual locations, selecting the best combination of cost and transit time.
* Set up and coordinate wrap\-and\-roll freight for game and equipment transfers between locations.
* Book and schedule freight shipments for asset transfers between locations.
* Track shipments in transit and proactively communicate ETAs, delays, and exceptions to the field and Parts \& Service Manager and affected locations.
* Prepare and review shipping documentation, including bills of lading, freight quotes, and tracking information, for accuracy.
* Negotiate rates and service terms with carriers and freight forwarders to control shipping costs.
* Maintain organized records of freight quotes, carrier contacts, and shipment history.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to reduce freight costs, transit times, and shipping errors.

**Key Responsibilities – Parts \& Service Support (Secondary)**

* Assist with picking, packing, and shipping parts orders to field locations.
* Assist with receiving, organizing, labeling, and storing parts inventory, maintaining proper par levels.
* Take and route incoming service calls from field technicians.
* Assist field technicians with parts identification, handling, and ordering processes.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory audits as needed.
* Assist with RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processing with manufacturers as needed.
* Provide general support to the Parts \& Service department as directed by the Parts \& Service Manager.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in logistics, freight coordination, shipping/receiving, or transportation coordination.
* Experience obtaining and comparing freight quotes; familiarity with LTL/FTL and wrap\-and\-roll freight preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines at once.
* Clear, proactive verbal and written communication with carriers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams.
* Comfortable using basic computer and database tools (Excel, inventory or ERP systems).
* Willingness and ability to take on secondary duties, including picking/packing parts, fielding service calls, and general department support.
* Must be physically capable of lifting 50\+ lbs and working in warehouse conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required; additional training in logistics or supply chain is a plus.

**ABOUT US**



HirexHire (pronounced hire by hire) is a Chicago\-based recruiting and talent consultancy that integrates with companies short\-term to provide long\-term talent solutions. We take a seat in our client’s everyday operations to understand their people's goals, gaps, and challenges. We then develop and implement the processes and technologies to execute a sustainable and scalable talent plan.



We partner with companies expecting or experiencing high growth that need to hire at scale or fill a critical role rapidly. Our clients are not looking for quick\-fix placements but are thoughtfully building a hiring strategy to scale their businesses.


**Location:** Remote within the Chicagoland area, with occasional in\-person team meetings and events  

**Compensation:** $45,000 \- $60,000 annually \+ bonus eligibility

As a Recruiting Coordinator, your focus is on supporting all aspects of the full lifecycle recruiting process in collaboration with our Recruiting Consultants, clients, and candidates. You can expect to help write job descriptions and manage job postings, source and screen resumes, coordinate interviews, and create, send, and collect offers and onboarding documents for our customers.



This person will be one of two primary points of contact for our clients regarding candidates in process, interview scheduling, and overall pipeline activity and metrics. **The Team:**



TAM is the premier destination at Okta for secure technical leadership. We ensure customers deploy Okta securely. We address short\-term customer needs through the lens of a robust, long\-term IAM strategy. We collaborate across the organization to provide a holistic experience throughout the customer journey. By bringing individual expertise and integrity to every interaction, Technical Account Managers help existing customers succeed, thereby fueling Okta's worldwide growth through higher renewal rates and expansions.


**The Opportunity:**



The **Technical Account Manager Analyst** role is vital in scaling how we drive success across Auth0 and adjacent technologies. This role sits within the Auth0 product unit at Okta, supporting the large and growing volume of customers in our digitally\-led engagement model to help maximize the value of their investment.



This position is for individuals who wish to build their career in a customer\-facing, technically\-minded SaaS team. Note: This is a hybrid role. This individual will be expected to come to Okta’s Chicago office (123 N Wacker Dr) at least 2 days per week.

* Continuously familiarize yourself with Okta’s product offerings and industry trends.

* Analytical and problem\-solving minded, detail and results\-oriented, and a quick learner.
* A passion to serve the customer by learning how to communicate complex ideas and solutions to their business challenges.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to set clear expectations and respectfully challenge assumptions
* Ability to diffuse tense situations
* Curiosity for – and eagerness to learn – new technologies, tools, or platform capabilities in order to apply them to meet customer needs.

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, perform customer research, generate reports, and analyze data.

* Basic knowledge of the software development lifecycle, as well as interest in cloud\-based infrastructure, solution design, integrations, and digital security.
* An interest in influencing customer behavior and health metrics to drive mutual success.
* Familiarity with SaaS platforms and services, their adoption, integration, and ongoing use.
* Experience in any of the following: Technical Support, Technical Account Management, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Solution Architect, or similar roles is a plus.
* Passionate for a career in Digital, SaaS / Cloud technology that requires technical acumen.

new_jobs.title: Partner Inside Sales Representative (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Lakeshore, we create innovative learning materials and world\-class guest experiences for teachers, parents and children. Since 1954, we’ve grown into a global community—with a thriving e\-commerce business, multiple catalogs, over 50 stores, a peerless national sales force, plus international offices that support our preeminent supply chain division. But today we’re working better, smarter and faster than ever—and setting our sights even higher. We’re building an infrastructure designed for scalability, embracing data\-driven decision\-making and using technology to improve efficiency and ensure the best tools for the best work. Most importantly, we continue to invest in a diverse team of inquisitive top talent who fuel each other’s passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.

 **Job Description** **The ideal candidate for the Partner Inside Sales Representative** is enthusiastic about education with a consultative, solution\-based approach to assisting customers. Primary focus on forging relationships and exceeding customers’ expectations. The right candidate has an outgoing personality and thrives on working in a collaborative environment. Strong communication skills will be needed as this role spends most of the day on the phone building lasting customer relationships. This is a fast\-paced and exciting sales role, and you will be tasked with growing new business and achieving sales quotas/daily activity goals. This role is fully remote, so candidates can be based anywhere in the US.

**A day on the job looks like this:**

* Collaborates with Outside Sales team members to drive site\-based customer outreach and key market penetration
* Organized, forwarding thinking, ability to create strong internal and cross\-functional partnerships
* Securing new and repeat business by building strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders via virtual appointments and outbound phone calls
* Consistently meeting, if not exceeding, activity requirements on a regular basis.
* Partnering with schools and childcare centers on a regular basis to assess emerging and ongoing needs
* Hosting virtual product presentations designed to familiarize customers with proprietary services (Complete Classrooms®, professional development, custom solutions, and more)
* Conducting online research to gather information pertaining to local, state and national trends and funding opportunities in early learning and elementary education
* Working with department leadership to form and modify sales strategies
* Partnering with outside sales, retail and our professional services group to support the needs of educators
* Identifying sales leads and collaborating with various members of the sales force to support the market
* Participating in weekly meetings with your team to discuss department initiatives and strategies
* Assisting team on special projects such as partnering with the outside sales force and participating in national and/or state campaigns

  

**Qualifications** **Got the skills and experience? Here is what we’re looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience making high volume outbound sales calls in an Inside Sales and/or Outside Sales role is required
* Preferred qualifications include a strong track record of sales success within the EC and K–5 education sector and deep familiarity with the industry's dynamics and decision\-making processes
* Strong work ethic, team player mentality, and ability to perform outstanding work from home
* Solid presentation skills and ability to speak to customer needs at all levels (teachers, administrators, directors)
* Highly coachable with an eagerness to learn and accept feedback
* Goal oriented and self\-motivated with a personal desire to improve and succeed
* Experience with Salesforce is a plus
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel) preferred
* Top\-notch written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent administrative and organizational skills
* Great attention to detail

  

**Additional Information** **And here’s our end of the bargain!**

* Hourly: $31\.50\-$34\.62
* Uncapped commission structure
* Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding
* Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage—EPO, PPO and HSA
* 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
* Flexible benefit options—choose what you like, ignore the rest
* Generous employee discount on products


At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.


We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it’s a great experience to be part of. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. To help maintain this high bar for success, we’re constantly on the lookout for people to join us. So if you’re a down\-to\-earth professional who shares our desire for making a difference, we’d love to hear from you.


To learn more about Lakeshore, visit www.lakeshorelearning.com/careers
